Calamity.description:
Hewn from a solid block of ensorcelled stone, this +1 striking greatsword is monumental in heft as well as destructive force. The weapon is named for the disbelieving leaders of the Seventh Army of Exploration, who denied the power of such a weapon and claimed their losses came from natural disasters. When wielded against creatures that are larger than you, the sword gains the sweep trait.

Activate—Shatter Legions 2 (earth)

Frequency once per day

Effect You smash the sword down upon the ground with the anger of a conquered land and a subjugated people. Each creature in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] takes @Damage[4d12[piercing]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:24|basic|traits:earth|options:area-damage] save as the earth shatters beneath their feet. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain the benefits of standard cover from the broken soil around you.
Calamity.name: Calamity

Hellhusk Shroud.description:
This hooded cloak is popular among those who must evade or surveil fiendish authorities. The grisly secrets behind this garment belies its innocuous appearance; its fabrics include threads woven from the hair, blood, and scales of various devils. When invested, a hellhusk shroud doesn't appear to radiate a magic aura to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} or similar spells unless the spells are 4th rank or higher. As long as you're wearing the cloak, you can read and speak Diabolic.

Activate—Horned Husk 1 (illusion, manipulate, olfactory, visual)

Frequency once per day

Effect The cloak wraps around you, becoming a second skin that suffuses you with Hell's corrosive brimstone. Your appearance becomes that of a nondescript low-level devil, and you gain a +1 status bonus to your Deception checks when you Lie to maintain your disguise. To creatures with scent, you also smell like a devil.

Activate—Hellish Senses 1 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You pull your hood up, allowing the remnants of fallen devils to nestle closely and whisper Hell's secrets. You gain fiendsense as an imprecise sense within 60 feet, allowing you to sense creatures with the fiend trait as a vague sense. This effect lasts for 10 minutes or until you take this action again.
Hellhusk Shroud.name: Hellhusk Shroud

Glittering Lights Snare.description:
布拉斯托瓦克的一些年轻人会制作这类圈套的简易版本来捉弄同伴。进入该格的生物会遭受到一连串快速闪烁的强光，使其感官过度刺激。该生物必须进行一次@Check[reflex|dc:22]豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]2轮。

失败 该生物目眩1分钟。

大失败 该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]1轮，之后再目眩1分钟。
Glittering Lights Snare.name: 幻光炫彩圈套 Glittering Lights Snare

Freezing Embrace Snare.description:
该圈套会将一具由附魔冰塊所制成的类人小雕像藏在该格的树叶或薄土层下。第一个进入圈套方格的生物会压碎雕像，并释放出由冰冷雾气构成的虚体人形缠绕住触发生物，造成@Damage[8d8[cold]]伤害。该生物必须进行一次@Check[fortitude|dc:26]豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半伤害，且因冰雾人形缠绕腿部而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 1}，持续1轮。

失败 该生物承受全额伤害，且因冰雾人形拥抱受到@Damage[1d6[persistent,cold]]伤害；只要该持续伤害存在，它就陷入笨拙1。

大失败 该生物承受双倍伤害，且因冰雾人形拥抱受到@Damage[2d6[persistent,cold]]伤害；只要该持续伤害存在，它就陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 Clumsy 2}。
Freezing Embrace Snare.name: 冰封之拥圈套 Freezing Embrace Snare

Mocking Mirror Snare.description: 一枚反光符文被隐藏在圈套所在格子中。进入该格子的生物会看见自身的扭曲幻象在附近突然出现，并做出其绝不会做的举动。该生物受到@Damage[8d6[mental]]伤害，并进行一次@Check[will|dc:25|basic]豁免。若豁免大失败，该生物还会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]状态，直到其下一轮结束。
Mocking Mirror Snare.name: 嘲讽魔镜圈套 Mocking Mirror Snare

Pit Illusion Snare.description:
你为魔法感应符文附加了幻术魔法，使目标在圈套触发时，坚信其脚下出现了一个无底深渊。进入该圈套所在格子的中型或更小体型生物，必须进行一次@Check[will|dc:20]豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物前进时变得极为谨慎，在其回合结束前，将圈套所在格及所有相邻方格视为困难地形。

失败 该生物@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。

大失败 该生物倒地，并承受@Damage[1d4[mental]]伤害。
Pit Illusion Snare.name: 幻陷圈套 Pit Illusion Snare

Puddle Shove Snare.description:
该圈套通过魔法封存一道高压水柱，并由隐形感应机关触发。当生物进入圈套方格时，水流会对其造成@Damage[4d10[bludgeoning]]伤害，并可能将其推开。你在制作该圈套时需确定水流冲击的方向。触发生物必须进行一次@Check[fortitude|dc:24]豁免。

大成功 该生物不受任何影响。

成功 该生物受到一半伤害。

失败 该生物受到全额伤害，并朝指定方向被推离10尺。

大失败 该生物受到双倍伤害，朝指定方向被推离15尺，同时被水浸湿，在1分钟内对抗电击效果的豁免检定承受-1环境减值。
Puddle Shove Snare.name: 水涌推斥圈套 Puddle Shove Snare

Shadow Cloak Snare.description: 当生物进入圈套格子时，会被笼罩在非自然的黑暗中，持续1分钟。光线无法进入该格子，格内所有非魔法光源都无法发出光亮，2环级及以下法术产生的魔法光源也会被压制。区域外的生物无法直接看穿或透视这片黑暗，且所有相邻格子的光照降低为昏暗光照。
Shadow Cloak Snare.name: 暗影披风圈套 Shadow Cloak Snare

Floppy Rag Doll.description:
This simple doll is made with scraps of cloth tied or sewn together into a basic humanoid shape, but its appearance belies its strange power over the actions of others. The head and limbs of the doll constantly droop and sway slightly, never able to remain in one position for very long. Whoever holds a floppy rag doll can feel it squirming in their grasp.

Activate—Loose Limbs 1 (manipulate, visual)

Frequency once per hour

Effect You brandish the floppy rag doll at a creature within 30 feet who can see you and shake it about. The creature's own limbs begin moving wildly in a similar fashion, and they must attempt a @Check[will|dc:19|options:inflicts:clumsy] saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target can't use reactions until the end your turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and can't use reactions until the beginning of your next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}
Floppy Rag Doll.name: Floppy Rag Doll

Lucky Silver.description:
These coins—copper, silver, or gold depending on their potency—were not minted for circulation. Rather, friendly fey helped to create them as wards against the abilities of some gremlins, namely pugwampis. The coins are said to protect the bearer against misfortunes of all stripes, though, not merely those of gremlins and have come to be seen as good luck charms the world over. Each coin, regardless of the metal used to mint it, has a canine face on both sides; on one side, the face's mouth is open in a wide smile, while the other shows the face snarling.

Activate—Guarded Fortune f (fortune, manipulate)

Trigger You fail a skill check or a saving throw due to a misfortune effect

Effect Flip the coin. If it lands on the smiling face, reroll the triggering check; since this activation has the fortune effect, any misfortune effect is canceled out for this check. You must use the new result, even if it's worse. If it lands on the snarling face, nothing happens. Either way, you're temporarily immune to Guarded Fortune for 1 hour.

Craft Requirements Any checks made to craft this item while under a misfortune effect are automatic critical failures.
Lucky Silver.name: Lucky Silver

Lucky Copper.description:
These coins—copper, silver, or gold depending on their potency—were not minted for circulation. Rather, friendly fey helped to create them as wards against the abilities of some gremlins, namely pugwampis. The coins are said to protect the bearer against misfortunes of all stripes, though, not merely those of gremlins and have come to be seen as good luck charms the world over. Each coin, regardless of the metal used to mint it, has a canine face on both sides; on one side, the face's mouth is open in a wide smile, while the other shows the face snarling.

Activate—Guarded Fortune f (fortune, manipulate)

Trigger You fail a skill check due to a misfortune effect

Effect Flip the coin. If it lands on the smiling face, reroll the triggering check; since this activation has the fortune effect, any misfortune effect is canceled out for this check. You must use the new result, even if it's worse. If it lands on the snarling face, nothing happens. Either way, you're temporarily immune to Guarded Fortune for 1 hour.

Craft Requirements Any checks made to craft this item while under a misfortune effect are automatic critical failures.
Lucky Copper.name: Lucky Copper

Cinnamon Nostalgia Bun.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

A swirl of cinnamon, sugar, and butter is baked into this fluffy bun. Pulling apart and eating the bun evokes comforting memories of happier times, reducing the value of your frightened condition by 1. You can also attempt an immediate flat check to recover from a single source of persistent mental damage, with the DC reduction from appropriate assistance.
Cinnamon Nostalgia Bun.name: Cinnamon Nostalgia Bun

Glacier Hammer.description:
Frost covers the head of this +1 magic maul. Any hit with this maul deals 1 extra cold damage. You can use a special action to transform the frost into giant icicles.

Activate—Grow Icicles 1 (concentrate) Until the end of your turn, the maul deals 1d6 extra cold damage instead of just 1. After you activate the glacier hammer, you can't activate it again for 10 minutes.
Glacier Hammer.name: Glacier Hammer

Conductor's Instrument.description:
This item can be found in the form of any variety of handheld musical instruments. The instrument grants you a +1 item bonus to Performance checks while playing music with it. Once per day, you can use the following activity.

Activate—Command Performance 2 (manipulate) You play a special tune on the instrument, causing it to cast a DC 17 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{Command} bard spell.
Conductor's Instrument.name: Conductor's Instrument

Sweet Hag's Eye.description:
This item appears to be a normal, if admittedly macabre, piece of hard peppermint candy the size and shape of a human eyeball. That's because it is actually the eye of a sweet hag, removed and painstakingly replaced with a mix of enchantment and cookery. It is typically mounted on a piece of jewelry or stored in a small sack worn on a cord.

The eye provides no direct benefit for the wearer, but the hag whose eye it once was can peer through it using the [[/act seek]] action, and cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{Message} cantrip through it onto the creature carrying the eye. Both these effects have no range limited, provided the hag is on the same plane.

Any damage to the eye destroys it. The sweet hag can also choose to destroy the eye remotely using Meltaway Mint. The eye can also be eaten, but a creature who attempts this is exposed to sickeningly sweet.

Activate—Meltaway Mint 1

Effect The hag causes the eye to melt away under a brief flare of intense heat. If a creature is holding the eye, they must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:18|options:damaging-effect] save. On a failure, they take @Damage[1d4[persistent,fire]] damage as the boiling hot candy remains stick to and burn their skin.

Sickeningly Sweet (ingested, poison) The sickened condition caused by this poison can't be ended until the poison's effects end

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:20|options:damaging-effect,inflicts:sickened|traits:ingested,poison]

Onset 1 minute

Maximum Duration 10 minutes;

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (1 minute)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (1 minute)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d8[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 3} (1 minute)

Craft Requirements You must be a sweet hag.
Sweet Hag's Eye.name: Sweet Hag's Eye

Guardian Rose.description:
Activate F (concentrate)

Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

This rose-shaped crystal brooch is a translucent bloodred. These talismans have saved the lives of many a soldier on the field of battle. When you activate a guardian rose, you avoid being knocked out and regain @Damage[(2d8+5)[healing]] Hit Points. However, this puts a strain on your body and you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of your next turn.
Guardian Rose.name: Guardian Rose

Lucky Gold.description:
These coins—copper, silver, or gold depending on their potency—were not minted for circulation. Rather, friendly fey helped to create them as wards against the abilities of some gremlins, namely pugwampis. The coins are said to protect the bearer against misfortunes of all stripes, though, not merely those of gremlins and have come to be seen as good luck charms the world over. Each coin, regardless of the metal used to mint it, has a canine face on both sides; on one side, the face's mouth is open in a wide smile, while the other shows the face snarling.

Activate—Guarded Fortune f (fortune, manipulate)

Trigger You fail a skill check, a saving throw, or an attack roll due to a misfortune effect

Effect Flip the coin. If it lands on the smiling face, reroll the triggering check; since this activation has the fortune effect, any misfortune effect is canceled out for this check. You must use the new result, even if it's worse. If it lands on the snarling face, nothing happens. Either way, you're temporarily immune to Guarded Fortune for 1 hour.

Craft Requirements Any checks made to craft this item while under a misfortune effect are automatic critical failures.
Lucky Gold.name: Lucky Gold

Vagabond's Teapot.description:
These ceramic teapots are highly valued by travelers. While the teapot is filled with water, a creature can use a single action with the concentrate trait to instantly heat the water to boiling, at which point the kettle whistles and the water inside begins to cool at a normal rate. While the water remains heated, it is piping hot, and a creature splashed with it takes @Damage[1d4[fire]|traits:nonlethal]{1d4 nonlethal fire damage}. Instead of filling the teapot with water, you can pour an elixir of 4th level or lower into the pot and use the following activation.

Activate—Share Brew 10 minutes (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect The teapot magically increases the volume of the inserted elixir to produce four uses of the same elixir. Once an elixir has been brewed in the teapot in this way, further attempts that day to brew another elixir spoil the inserted liquid. Any brewed elixir not consumed by the time it cools (typically 10 minutes) loses its alchemical properties.
Vagabond's Teapot.name: Vagabond's Teapot

Restorative Handwraps.description: Glowing runes cover these +1 striking handwraps of mighty blows. When you critically hit an enemy with a Strike as part of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.nbfNETdpee8CVM17]{Flurry of Blows}, you can regain @Damage[4[healing,vitality]|traits:healing,vitality]{4 Hit Points}. This is a healing vitality effect. The handwraps can heal you only once every 10 minutes.
Restorative Handwraps.name: Restorative Handwraps

Last Word Stone.description:
This small, palm-sized smooth crystal has a translucent gray coloration. But with a whisper from the lips of the desperate, a last word stone can be filled with a spark of memory, changing its appearance to an opaque, polished stone that is strangely warm to the touch. These divinely infused objects were initially created by Pharasmin priests to preserve a dying person's last moment of life should loved ones be delayed in their arrival at the dying person's side. But with the tragedy of Lastwall, last word stones have gained a new, more desperate purpose. Here, along the Gravelands border regions, refugees and adventurers have taken to using last word stones to impart important details to recipients outside of endangered places when it seems likely they won't survive to spread the news themselves.

Activate—Capture Memory 3 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Requirements The last word stone doesn't contain a memory

Effect You press an empty last word stone to an adjacent willing creature's head. The stone fills with an important memory from the creature's mind, then becomes opaque in appearance. The memory is duplicated, and remains in the target creature's thoughts, but no indication of what type of memory is held within the stone is discernible to anyone else. Which memory is placed in the last word stone is chosen by the creature from whom the memory is copied, and once a memory is stored, the stone can't be used again to Capture Memory. A stored memory can't contain much information beyond a single emotion and a hazy mental picture that, taken together, convey a short message of no more than 10 words—typically enough to impart final words of comfort to a loved one, or to warn one of a specific location that might be trapped, or to impart a bit of news about a noteworthy event. The limit of 10 words represents the hazy and sometimes confusing nature of the mental image.

Activate—Reveal Memory 3 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Requirements The last word stone contains a memory

Effect You hold the last word stone to your head and concentrate on its contents. A moment later, the stored memory plays out in your mind and the last word stone crumbles to dust in your hand.
Last Word Stone.name: Last Word Stone

Tearaway Paper Doll.description:
Activate 1 (concentrate, manipulate)

A humanoid shape has been cut out of a single sheet of colored paper with a face and clothes drawn on. The face looks slightly worried, as if the doll knows what it was made for. You hold up the paper doll in two hands and rip it half, focusing your thoughts on a creature within 20 feet that you can see. That creature takes @Damage[3d6[slashing]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:18|basic] save) as the tears of the paper doll are mimicked on its body.
Tearaway Paper Doll.name: Tearaway Paper Doll

Hagbane Biscuit.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This gingerbread biscuit is stamped in the shape of a menacing witch, her features decorated with anise and fennel seeds. When you eat the biscuit, its sharp spices warm your body for 10 minutes, granting you a +1 status bonus Perception checks to pierce a hag's disguise, to skill checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about hags, and to saving throws made against hags' abilities and spells. During this time, weapons you wield count as cold iron for any physical attacks made against hags.

The biscuit tastes especially bitter to hags, changelings, and other hag-related creatures (such as a sorcerer with the hag bloodline). If such a creature attempts to eat the biscuit, they must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:18|options:inflicts:sickened] save or it fails and wastes the action (and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} on a critical failure).
Hagbane Biscuit.name: Hagbane Biscuit

Warpriest's Cascade (Major).description:
This iron thurible—originally crafted by a Caydenite priest to disperse symbolic libations—swings from the end of an extendable shaft, allowing you to sprinkle the contents over an entire troop.

The thurible's container can hold a magical potion up to the item level of the warpriest's cascade, dispersing its contents over an entire troop over the course of 1 minute. However, spreading out the potion lessens its duration. Potions with a duration of 1 hour or more affect a troop for only 10 minutes, and potions with a duration of 8 hours or more affect a troop for only 1 hour. Potions with a duration less than 1 hour don't work inside of a warpriest's cascade.
Warpriest's Cascade (Major).name: Warpriest's Cascade (Major)

Sawtooth Reaper.description:
这件+2高等强击锐锋血光锁镰的锯齿刀刃和链条闪烁着血红色的光。一抹血红色的薄雾从刀刃上飘散出来。

启动—诱捕卸武（Ensnaring Disarm） r

触发 触及内一个敌人在对你的一次近战武器打击中失手

效果 你对触发生物尝试[[/act disarm]]。即便你没有空手你也可以这么做。

启动—血雾回旋（Bloodmist Whirl） 1（专注，操作）

频率 每小时一次

效果 你旋转锯齿镰刀的锁链，创造出一片能使你隐蔽的猩红雾气，持续1轮或直到你进行打击。你进行的下次打击将目标视作@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]，且当你使用诱捕卸武时你还可以用自由动作打击同一目标。
Sawtooth Reaper.name: 锯齿镰刀 Sawtooth Reaper

Mordant Mask.description:
戴上这个木制面具时，你的耳边会不断响起如同海浪拍岸般的低语声。这些舒缓的声音赋予你在对抗情绪效果时的意志豁免和意志DC+1物品加值。

启动—惊涛拍岸（Pounding Surf） r（专注）

帕鲁 每日一次

触发 你将受到一个听觉效果影响

效果 海浪的声响愈发压倒性地轰鸣，盖过所有其他声音。你对所有其他声响@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]，直至你的下一回合结束。你能维持该启动最多1分钟。
Mordant Mask.name: 莫丹特面具 Mordant Mask

Cloak of Social Graces (Greater).description:
These cloaks are created from hand-dyed leather decorated with gemstones, appealing to the individual tastes of the owner. The beautiful decorations of these cloaks encourage their owner to wear them no matter the season, making it visibly part of their unique style. Wearing the cloak boosts self-confidence, granting a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks.

Activate—Overcome Self-Doubt 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You readjust your cloak, straightening the collar and brushing out any wrinkles. You gain the effects of a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KqvqNAfGIE5a9wSv]{Heroism} spell for 1 minute.
Cloak of Social Graces (Greater).name: Cloak of Social Graces (Greater)

Kinetic Wraps of Strength (Greater).description:
These tightly woven strips strengthen the hands and arms, allowing for the wearer to increase their application of force while lifting heavy loads, and shoving past blockades. Promise sculptors primarily use them to handle large blocks of stone, moving them around as they prepare to carve them. You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act force-open]], [[/act reposition]], and [[/act shove]].

Activate—Burst of Might f (fortune, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt an Athletics check to Force Open, Reposition, or Shove

Effect You roll the skill check twice and take the better result.
Kinetic Wraps of Strength (Greater).name: Kinetic Wraps of Strength (Greater)

Amulet of the Slumberer.description:
Companion Item to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.L6HpgX8EsBWCRJ3u]{The Eye of the Slumberer}.

Only one such amulet can exist at any given time, and the artifact can grow a new one in 10 minutes if the original is destroyed. The Eye's abilities that require a saving throw use the higher of the amulet wearer's spell DC or class DC.
Amulet of the Slumberer.name: Amulet of the Slumberer

Crown of the Master.description: 这顶头冠被阿尔古苏尊主授予其偏爱的阿扎克缇人，由珊瑚雕刻成触手生物的形状，紧紧抓住穿戴者的太阳穴。穿戴头冠时，你在对抗心灵效果的豁免上获得+1物品加值，且能够以异能内在法术的形式施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]。
Crown of the Master.name: 尊主之冠 Crown of the Master

Amaranthine Visage.description:
这具2尺高的木制面具形如莫丹特尖塔，由居住于此的精灵秘密领袖所佩戴。佩戴时，你的脏腑会化作紫色烟雾，赋予你对精准伤害的10点抗力。

启动—永恒复苏（Eternal Renewal） r（治疗）

频率 每日一次

触发 你的濒死状态将要达到会使你死亡的数值

效果 你自我升华。你失去濒死状态，正常获得或增加受伤状态，并获得快速治疗20，持续1分钟。即使@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]或因其他原因无法行动时，你也可以使用永恒复苏。

启动—自我升华（Sublimate Self） 2（气，专注，变形）你的身体完全变为紫色的蒸汽，持续5分钟，并获得汽化形体的效果。
Amaranthine Visage.name: 不凋面容 Amaranthine Visage

Whispering Veil.description:
这幅深色木制面具的眼洞和耳洞周围雕刻着同心圆，能让你听到充斥在莫丹特尖塔中的低语。充满耳朵的细微难辨的低语向你警示着危险，赋予你在对抗意图伤害你的事物（例如敌对生物和作祟，由GM裁量）时，你在用于先攻，[[/act seek]]，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]或[[/act sense-motive]]的察觉检定上获得+1物品加值。当你和敌人的先攻值相等时，你会先行动。

启动—尖塔之力（Spire Power） f（专注）

频率 每日一次

触发 你即将尝试一次你的神话感召允许你花费神话点的检定

效果 你汲取莫丹特尖塔的力量。你获得1点神话点，可用来尝试该检定。若你回合结束时未使用此神话点，则会失去它。若你在此检定上取得大成功，不会重获神话点（即便这是当日首次大成功），但后续大成功仍会照常重获。

启动—未知先觉（Unforeseen Alert） f

需求 一个你未意识到的生物或危害将你作为目标或把你包含在一个区域效果内，且你没有@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]

效果 低语警告你即将到来的危险。你立即获得一个反应动作，该反应动作只能用于响应触发动作或效果。
Whispering Veil.name: 低语面罩 Whispering Veil

Golden Wings (Major).description:
This pair of huge wings is crafted from numerous feathers made of a lightweight, golden magical alloy. When activated, the wings emit a melodic sound and a shimmering glow.

Activate—Assisted Flight 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect For the next 10 minutes, you can [[/act leap]] 20 feet, using the wings to propel yourself. You must land on a space with solid ground. For the duration, you also emit a bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for the next 20 feet. You take a –2 item penalty to Stealth checks to [[/act hide]] and [[/act sneak]].

You can also use an action to flap the wings to glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 20 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend 1 action gliding each round and haven't yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.

You gain a fly Speed of 20 feet for the duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.7uih4ELs2cePqkF2]{Effect: Assisted Flight}
Golden Wings (Major).name: Golden Wings (Major)

Coral Aspect.description:
这副面具由石化木制成，形态宛若一片珊瑚礁。佩戴时，你在用于游泳的运动检定上获得+1物品加值，且你穿戴的任何护甲都会获得水下特征。

启动—共栖（Cohabitate） 2（专注，操作，变形）

频率 每日一次

效果 在1分钟内，你的身躯变为一座移动的珊瑚礁，令比你小得多的生物得以穿行或藏身其中。比你至少小一个体型的生物可与你共享空间。和你共享空间的盟友在AC上获得+2环境加值，且你对与你共享空间的生物造成的任何伤害获得5点抗力。
Coral Aspect.name: 珊瑚面相 Coral Aspect

Warpriest's Cascade.description:
This iron thurible—originally crafted by a Caydenite priest to disperse symbolic libations—swings from the end of an extendable shaft, allowing you to sprinkle the contents over an entire troop.

The thurible's container can hold a magical potion up to the item level of the warpriest's cascade, dispersing its contents over an entire troop over the course of 1 minute. However, spreading out the potion lessens its duration. Potions with a duration of 1 hour or more affect a troop for only 10 minutes, and potions with a duration of 8 hours or more affect a troop for only 1 hour. Potions with a duration less than 1 hour don't work inside of a warpriest's cascade.
Warpriest's Cascade.name: Warpriest's Cascade

Warmaster's Baton.description:
This double-ended silver baton functions as a mundane silver mace. Its shining surface glimmers in the light, making it easy to signal and inspire troops.

Activate—Rally Forth f (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger An enemy triggers a reaction from a troop you're currently commanding, but that troop has already used its reaction this turn

Effect The troop under your command gains a second reaction that they must immediately use against the triggering enemy.
Warmaster's Baton.name: Warmaster's Baton

Gaze of the Mantis.description:
这些眼镜拥有像螳螂一样的多面红色镜片，作为全脸面具的低调替代品，它们很受欢迎。穿戴螳螂的凝视时，你的视野会扩大，使你更好地感知周围环境。你在视觉察觉检定上获得+2物品加值，且不会被夹击。

启动—目标感知（Target Sense） 1

频率 每日一次

需求 你是红螳螂刺客

效果 你获知10英里内所有身上有红螳螂契约的生物的距离和方位。如果这些生物之一处于100尺内，你还会知道影响他们的所有苦难、状态和法术。这种感知持续1小时。
Gaze of the Mantis.name: 螳螂的凝视 Gaze of the Mantis

Gloves of Precision (Greater).description:
These fingerless gloves increase the agility and sensitivity of the hands, enabling the wearer to perform more delicate, precise work. While wearing the gloves of precision, you gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act climb]], and to Thievery checks to [[/act disable-device]] and [[/act pick-a-lock]].

Activate—Nimble Fingers f (fortune, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt a skill check to Climb, Disable a Device, or Pick a Lock

Effect You roll the skill check twice and take the better result.
Gloves of Precision (Greater).name: Gloves of Precision (Greater)

Bloodstride Blade.description:
这件+2高等强击诡诈血光锯齿剑貌似生锈，但永远不会失去锋芒。它会被你目标的血吸引。你在[[/act seek]]或[[/act track]]拥有血液的生物时获得+2物品加值。

启动—嗜血的呼唤（Call of the Bloodthirst） r

频率 每小时一次

触发 60尺内一个生物受到流血伤害

效果 你施放次元移位，在与目标相邻处现身，然后用此武器打击它。生物对此次攻击@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。
Bloodstride Blade.name: 觅血刀 Bloodstride Blade

Sanguine Ammunition.description:
弹药 任意

启动 1（操作）

这种邪恶带着倒钩的弹药看起来甚至触摸都很危险。它在撞击时会溶解成血液，如果目标拥有血液，则不会留下任何痕迹。目标在对抗疾病和毒素的豁免上承受-2环境减值，持续1轮。

你也可以作为施法的一部分启动血术弹药。法术必须为3环或更低环级，必须花费1或2个动作来施放，必须具有毒素或疾病特征，并且必须以施法者以外的一个生物为目标。以这种方式施法没有效果；相反，被以这种方式启动的血术弹药命中的生物除了物品的正常效果外，还会成为该法术的目标。如果目标不是该法术的有效目标，则法术失效。

弹药只影响被命中的目标。如果该法术需要法术攻击，则使用你的远程攻击掷骰结果来确定法术的成功度。如果该法术需要豁免，则目标尝试豁免对抗你的法术DC。

这件+2高等强击三叉戟由金色金属制成，其握柄雕刻着波浪和海贝的浮雕。这些三叉戟通常由在阿尔古苏军队中担任高位的阿扎克缇士兵使用。

Mariner’s Mien (Greater).description:
这个木面具上的漩涡——常为莫丹特审判官所佩戴——会移动与变换，映出最近水流的形态。佩戴面具能赋予你的航海学识与生存检定的+2物品加值。此外，它还能让你仅以意念驾船。当你驾驶载具时，你可以双手空闲，并在载具上的任意位置进行驱动。

Kinetic Wraps of Strength.description:
These tightly woven strips strengthen the hands and arms, allowing for the wearer to increase their application of force while lifting heavy loads, and shoving past blockades. Promise sculptors primarily use them to handle large blocks of stone, moving them around as they prepare to carve them. You gain a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks to [[/act force-open]], [[/act reposition]], and [[/act shove]].

Activate—Burst of Might f (fortune, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You attempt an Athletics check to Force Open, Reposition, or Shove

Effect You roll the skill check twice and take the better result.
Kinetic Wraps of Strength.name: Kinetic Wraps of Strength

The Eye of the Slumberer.description:
The Eye of the Slumberer is an alghollthu relic resembling a tangle of barnacle-encrusted tentacles. Though the orb is too large to move easily, the artifact's owner (referred to as the bearer) can activate its powers by wearing the Amulet of the Slumberer, a companion item shaped like a barnacle-encrusted cephalopod eye; this is a worn item that has the invested and occult traits. Only one such amulet can exist at any given time, and the artifact can grow a new one in 10 minutes if the original is destroyed. The Eye's abilities that require a saving throw use the higher of the amulet wearer's spell DC or class DC.

As one of the alghollthus' ancient contingencies to control their servitors, the Eye absorbs thoughts—especially those of pain and anguish—storing them like a battery. On command, it can unleash the stored energy, potentially stunning whole ecosystems. Each time a creature with the aquatic, amphibious, or water trait falls asleep or otherwise passes the night within 1 mile of the Eye of the Slumberer, it dreams fitfully of the artifact; creatures that don't dream are immune to this effect. When it awakens, the creature must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:45] save or become friendly toward the bearer (or helpful on a critical failure) until the next time it rests; this is an emotion and mental effect. The Amulet's bearer isn't automatically aware of creatures influenced in this fashion, but they can identify such creatures on sight.

Activate—Open the Eye 2 (manipulate, occult)

Frequency once per day

Requirements You are wearing the Amulet of the Slumberer and are within 100 feet of the Eye of the Slumberer

Effect The amulet's eye opens and absorbs fears from creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20], subjecting them to nightmare as if they'd spent a night under the influence of the spell. Additionally, each creature with the dream or incorporeal trait within 500 feet of the Eye of the Slumberer takes @Damage[20d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:45|basic] save).

Activate—Vortex 1 (occult, water)

Requirements You're wearing the Amulet of the Slumberer, you're within 100 feet of the Eye of the Slumberer, and the Eye is within water

Effect The water around the Eye churns violently in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30], becoming difficult terrain for swimming creatures that don't have the water trait. You can use this action again to Dismiss this effect.

Destruction The Eye of the Slumberer is destroyed if it's brought to the Dreamlands and either fed to a Great Old One or encircled by joyful celebrants for 101 days, during which time none of the dancers can experiences despair.
The Eye of the Slumberer.name: The Eye of the Slumberer

Helm of the Tides.description:
这件银色，流线型的头盔外表上刻着蜿蜒的波浪图案。你在用于游泳的运动检定上获得+2物品加值。

启动—涨潮（Raise the Tide） 2（操作）

频率 每日一次

效果 你施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zfn5RqAdF63neqpP]。如果你在夜里施放，法术的区域变为100尺长乘100尺宽。
Helm of the Tides.name: 潮汐头盔 Helm of the Tides

这双猩红的皮靴贪婪地吸收着接触到的任何血液。

启动—鲜血跳跃（Blood Hop） 2（专注，操作）

频率 每小时一次

效果 靴子在你脚下和120尺内你能看见的空出的空间生成一小滩血液。你融入你脚下的血池中，然后在另一处血池中重组，如同次元移位的效果。

需求 你站在血液中

效果 你融入地面，并在100英里内你先前见过的地点重组，如同次元移位的效果。如果该地点在24小时内没有知性生物死亡，此效果便会失败。

Requirements You're leading a troop

这件斗篷由吸收水分的绿松石色鳞片制成，可以为穿戴者提供水分。在完全浸入水中1小时后，斗篷允许水生生物，例如阿扎克缇人，在不受到减值的情况下离开水停留至多1周，之后必须再次浸入水中。

Hydration Cloak.name: 合水斗篷 Hydration Cloak

Cloak of Social Graces.description:
These cloaks are created from hand-dyed leather decorated with gemstones, appealing to the individual tastes of the owner. The beautiful decorations of these cloaks encourage their owner to wear them no matter the season, making it visibly part of their unique style. Wearing the cloak boosts self-confidence, granting a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks.

Activate—Overcome Self-Doubt 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You readjust your cloak, straightening the collar and brushing out any wrinkles. You gain the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KqvqNAfGIE5a9wSv]{Heroism} spell for 1 minute.
Cloak of Social Graces.name: Cloak of Social Graces

Golden Liberator's Feather.description:
Activate F or 1 (concentrate)

Requirements You don't have the unholy trait.

This pristine feather is plucked from a mighty celestial, such as Talmandor. When you activate the talisman, you sprout feathery wings until the end of your turn, granting you a fly Speed of 50 feet and a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by your movement. You then Fly. If you activate the talisman with 1 action, the wings buffet adjacent enemies either before or after you Fly, dealing @Damage[8d8[spirit]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:41|basic] save).

Crown of the Master (Greater).description:
这顶头冠被阿尔古苏尊主授予其偏爱的阿扎克缇人，由珊瑚雕刻成触手生物的形状，紧紧抓住穿戴者的太阳穴。穿戴头冠时，你在对抗心灵效果的豁免上获得+2物品加值，且能够以异能内在法术的形式施放@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]。

启动—支配指令（Imperative Order） 2（专注）

频率 每日一次

效果 你施放DC为30的6环级支配术。当你以此法施放支配术时，其持续时间减少至8小时。
Crown of the Master (Greater).name: 高等尊主之冠 Crown of the Master (Greater)

This iron thurible—originally crafted by a Caydenite priest to disperse symbolic libations—swings from the end of an extendable shaft, allowing you to sprinkle the contents over an entire troop.

The thurible's container can hold a magical potion up to the item level of the warpriest's cascade, dispersing its contents over an entire troop over the course of 1 minute. However, spreading out the potion lessens its duration. Potions with a duration of 1 hour or more affect a troop for only 10 minutes, and potions with a duration of 8 hours or more affect a troop for only 1 hour. Potions with a duration less than 1 hour don't work inside of a warpriest's cascade.

Oneiric Crystals of the Slumberer.description:
这些梯形水晶是由一位强大的阿尔古苏尊主用早已被遗忘的深海岩石创造出来的。它们被用来窃取尊主受害者的梦境和记忆，将它们困在其中，以便在需要时进行查询。当水晶被打碎时，那些被窃取记忆的生物会将其取回，但陷入呆滞1，持续1轮。

启动—窃取记忆（Steal Remembrance） 2（专注，操作）

频率 每日一次

效果 选择一个你能看见的生物，将其记忆困在水晶中。该生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:31]豁免。如果该生物处于睡眠状态，则其使用比掷骰结果低一级的成功度。

大成功 生物不受影响且明白你在尝试偷取它的记忆。

成功 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}，持续1轮，但不会失去任何记忆，且相信你在做一些损害它心智的事情。

失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}，持续1小时，且失去某个可以用不超过50个词描述的特定话题的所有记忆。

大失败 生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 4}，持续1天，且失去两个分别可以用不超过50个词描述的特定话题的所有记忆。
Oneiric Crystals of the Slumberer.name: 沉眠者的幻梦水晶 Oneiric Crystals of the Slumberer

Warmaster's Baton (Greater).description:
This double-ended silver baton functions as a mundane silver mace. Its shining surface glimmers in the light, making it easy to signal and inspire troops.

Activate—Rally Forth f (concentrate)

Frequency once per hour

Trigger An enemy triggers a reaction from a troop you're currently commanding, but that troop has already used its reaction this turn

Effect The troop under your command gains a second reaction that they must immediately use against the triggering enemy.
Warmaster's Baton (Greater).name: Warmaster's Baton (Greater)

Cloak of Social Graces (Major).description:
These cloaks are created from hand-dyed leather decorated with gemstones, appealing to the individual tastes of the owner. The beautiful decorations of these cloaks encourage their owner to wear them no matter the season, making it visibly part of their unique style. Wearing the cloak boosts self-confidence, granting a +3 item bonus to Diplomacy checks.

Activate—Overcome Self-Doubt 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You readjust your cloak, straightening the collar and brushing out any wrinkles. You gain the effects of a 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KqvqNAfGIE5a9wSv]{Heroism} spell for 1 minute.
Cloak of Social Graces (Major).name: Cloak of Social Graces (Major)

Winged Terror.description: 这件+2高等韧性插翅镶嵌皮甲在其甲片铆钉上装饰有红螳螂的徽记。穿戴者对陷入惊惧的生物所造成的物理伤害获得抗力5。
Winged Terror.name: 插翅骇物 Winged Terror

Arclord Eye.description:
These tattoos take the form of an eye nestled within a triangle and are usually worn on the brow; their inks are said to be distilled from rare materials found only within the Crux of Nex. However, their popularity casts some doubt upon this claim. When you target a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} creature with a magical effect or spell, you reduce the DC of the flat check to 3.

Activate—Open the Eye 1 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect For the next 10 minutes, you gain an imprecise magic sense with a range of 30 feet. This allows you to detect spells, magical effects, and magical items within range. You also learn the rank or level of such magical effects and their traits. Deceptive illusion magic is not detectable by this magic sense.
Arclord Eye.name: Arclord Eye

Serpent's Lash.description:
This +1 striking whip was fashioned with the enchanted leather of a giant serpent. Several vicious fangs are embedded in the thong and fall of the whip. When wielded in combat, the weapon emanates a faint rattling sound.

Activate—Slither Strike r

Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature within reach Casts a Spell with the manipulate trait

Effect You Strike the triggering creature with the whip. If you hit and deal damage, you also [[/act reposition]] the creature 5 feet (10 feet on a critical hit).
Serpent's Lash.name: Serpent's Lash

Deflecting.name: 偏折 Deflecting
Deflecting.description:
当使用蚀刻了此符文的武器进行格挡时，你有可能减少你所受的伤害。

启动—偏转格挡（Deflecting Parry） r

频率 每日一次

触发 你被一次造成物理伤害的打击重击

需求 你正受益于武器格挡特征的AC加值

效果 你针对触发打击获得5点物理伤害抗力。

Self-Sealing.description: 蚀刻着此符文的护甲可生成一层防护魔法层，将自己封闭起来以保护穿戴者免受危险环境。当你即将受到环境伤害，或进入无法安全呼吸的环境时，你的自封护甲会自行密封。密封时，它可容纳1分钟的空气，并给予你对环境伤害的10点抗力。你或另一个生物可随时以一个交互动作解除密封。一旦解除密封，该护甲在1小时内无法再次自行密封。
Self-Sealing.name: 自封 Self-Sealing

Pick of Arcane Accuracy.description:
The metal head of this +1 striking pick glows faintly, intensifying around the tip. The hilt features a grip wrapped in deep-blue leather and is carved with a hawk's wings.

Activate—Mystic Strike 1

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements Your last action was to Cast a non-cantrip Spell

Effect You make a melee Strike with the pick that overflows with magical energy. You gain a +1 status bonus to this Strike, and if you hit, you deal an additional @Damage[1d4[persistent,force]] damage.
Pick of Arcane Accuracy.name: Pick of Arcane Accuracy

Wandmender.description:
Nearly every surface of this heavy +1 striking mace is inscribed with runes of crafting and restoration. The core of the mace hums with an eerie resonance, as if devouring stray magical energies from the air.

Activate—Recharge Wand 1 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Requirements You're wielding a wand capable of casting spells of 3rd rank or lower, and its spell has been cast for the day

Effect You tap the wandmender against the wand, restoring its magic. You can Cast the Spell in the wand a second time without overcharging, as long as you do so within the next minute.
Wandmender.name: Wandmender

Watch of Lost Ages.description: The origins of the watch of lost ages, a silver pocket watch, are enigmatic. Its construction matches no known culture, and its appearance shifts back and forth from battered and tarnished to shiny and new without cause or apparent reason. The watch exudes a sense of melancholy and loss, and anyone holding it is acutely aware of the impermanence of all things and the march of time, moving ever forward. This relic might show up in a mysterious ruin or spontaneously appear in a spellcaster's hand after they cast a time spell. The relic grants you a +1 item bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about historical subjects.
Watch of Lost Ages.name: Watch of Lost Ages
Watch of Lost Ages.gmnote:
Aspects emotion (misery), time

Minor Gifts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.RsdpWLg1FGHVUXK6]{Fervor}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.vhkmU56jQowrZId1]{Sands of the Hourglass}

Major Gifts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.c3Dfn1xf7WP8I3ei]{Fervent Spell}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.sRrio44rXyUpiD8J]{Temporal Pulse}

Grand Gift @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.nqvcehh10TCwADjE]{Time Reversal}

Gravebane Ammunition.description:
Ammunition any

Activate 1 (manipulate)

First made to deal with a wicked necromancer's encroaching horde, gravebane ammunition is crafted with materials soaked in blessed waters. On a successful Strike, the attack deals an additional @Damage[1d10[vitality]] damage to creatures with void healing. If the target takes vitality damage, it must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:19] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} on a critical failure) until the start of your next turn.
Gravebane Ammunition.name: Gravebane Ammunition

Sparking Grimoire.description:
The black leather cover of this spellbook is embossed with a pattern of lightning, and sparks crackle across it. Touching the book makes one's hair stand slightly on end.

Activate—Static Shock f (concentrate, electricity, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your next action is to Cast a prepared Spell with the electricity trait, you charge yourself with electrical energy. Until the end of your next turn, your Strikes deal an additional @Damage[2d6[electricity]] damage, and creatures targeting you with a melee Strike or spell with a range of touch take @Damage[2d6[electricity]] damage, with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC.
Sparking Grimoire.name: Sparking Grimoire

Magekiller Bullet.description:
Ammunition round or sling bullet

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Magekiller bullets are forged by carving a spellcaster's bones with sigils of unbinding, grinding them to powder, and sealing the powder within the core of specially made rounds or sling bullets. When an activated magekiller bullet hits a target, the ammunition burrows deep into its body and interferes with its connection to magic.

Each time within the next week an affected target Casts a Spell, it must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]. On a failure, it takes @Damage[2d12[force]] damage. This curse can be counteracted with cleanse affliction as normal, but if the ammunition is first removed from the target with a successful @Check[medicine|dc:35] check and an operation that takes 1 hour, the counteract check gains a +4 circumstance bonus.
Magekiller Bullet.name: Magekiller Bullet

Sparking Grimoire (Greater).name: Sparking Grimoire (Greater)
Sparking Grimoire (Greater).description:
The black leather cover of this spellbook is embossed with a pattern of lightning, and sparks crackle across it. Touching the book makes one's hair stand slightly on end.

Activate—Static Shock f (concentrate, electricity, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your next action is to Cast a prepared Spell with the electricity trait, you charge yourself with electrical energy. Until the end of your next turn, you and your allies' Strikes deal an additional @Damage[2d6[electricity]] damage, and creatures targeting you with a melee Strike or spell with a range of touch take @Damage[2d6[electricity]] damage, with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC.

Chapbook of Terrors.description:
This lurid pamphlet contains spooky tales about ghosts, monsters, and murderers, all illustrated in gruesome detail. The stories, fortunately, are only fictions… or are they?

Activate—Horrify 1 (concentrate, mental, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your next action is to Cast a prepared Spell with the fear trait, creatures frightened by the spell also take @Damage[1d6[persistent,mental]] damage as they dwell on your terrifying tale.
Chapbook of Terrors.name: Chapbook of Terrors

Soulheart (Major).description:
A soulheart is a crystallized sphere of red ectoplasm about the size of a human eye. When held by a living creature, a faint red light shimmers within the crystal, pulsating in a synchronized beat with the creature's heartbeat and providing illumination equivalent to that of a candle.

Activate—Bolster Life 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect When held to the chest and focused upon, the soul energy within the soulheart floods outward and bolsters your life force, granting you 18 temporary Hit Points (or 9 temporary Hit Points if it's nighttime). These temporary Hit Points last for 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.iiQSTRA8EVCvlfDQ]{Effect: Bolster Life}

Activate—Bolster Maiserene Phantom 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Effect When touched to a rank 2 Maiserene phantom, the soulheart flashes with bright red light and is destroyed. As it does so, it permanently increases the targeted phantom to rank 3, and increases each PC's maximum Hit Points by 3 for as long as they remain within Bastardhall while the castle remains cursed.

Destruction A soulheart is destroyed when it is activated to Bolster Maiserene Phantom.
Soulheart (Major).name: Soulheart (Major)

Convincing (Major).description: 服众符文会融入你护甲的装饰元素中，例如浮雕图案和彩色饰物。穿戴此护甲时，你在[[/act make-an-impression]]和请求的交涉检定中获得+3物品加值。
Convincing (Major).name: 上等服众 Convincing (Major)

Irrokcis's Medallion.name: Irrokcis's Medallion
Irrokcis's Medallion.gmnote:
Each Arudora memento is unique in appearance, but all seven are approximately the same size. Carried by each of the cursed family members, these mementos have within them the power to unlock entire portions of Bastardhall from the ghostly cursed state the castle traditionally exists in.

Activate—Return Memento 3 (manipulate) You place the memento into the appropriate statue's clutches in the fountain located in area B3 of Bastardhall. The statue briefly animates to claim the memento, which turns to stone and becomes thereafter a permanent part of the statue, effectively destroying the memento while granting a boon to the party that persists for the remainder of this Adventure Path. When this eerie medallion is Returned, the towers (detailed in Chapter 9) are unlocked, and the spirits of those trapped in Bastardhall rise up to aid the PCs. All weapon Strikes made by PCs deal an additional @Damage[1[spirit]] damage for the rest of the Adventure Path.

Destruction An Arudora memento is destroyed when it's activated with Return Memento, and the boon it grants upon this returning lasts until the very end of the Adventure Path.

Whispering Remnant.description:
A whispering remnant appears as a raw, decaying mass of flesh, fur, and gristle—a teratoma consisting of warty skin, sightless eyes, a finger or a toe, tufts of bristly hair, or teeth without mouths or lips to hide them. Each whispering remnant's shape is wildly different and uniquely unsettling.

Activate—Hear My Words 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect The whispering remnant casts a DC 30 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IihxWhRfpsBgQ5jS]{Enthrall} spell to your specifications. Creatures that fail or critically fail to resist this spell perceive and remember the whispering remnant in your hand as something commonplace to the region, such as a farming tool, book, or fresh-baked pie, for as long as they remain enthralled. If you don't take advantage of this to subtly guide any affected creatures toward undermining their society, the whispering remnant can't be activated to Hear My Words again by you for 1 week. Additionally, the next time you sleep, you endure horrific nightmares and must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:23] save upon waking to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 24 hours (this is a mental effect).
Whispering Remnant.name: Whispering Remnant
Whispering Remnant.gmnote:
When dislodged, mortal fragments like a chewed fingernail, a careless sneeze, or a few strands of hair might fall to the soil and be swiftly forgotten. When a horror like Charg brushes close to reality, the whispering remnants cast off from his nightmare form are not so harmless. At other times, the desecrated remains of innocent creatures can be transformed into whispering remnants as well. Worshippers of unholy gods and followers of evil philosophies gather these things and covet them as one might the hem of a cloak brushed against an idolized hero, or the visage of a divinity made manifest in a patch of mold on a wall. whispering remnants spread fear and cruelty wherever they're hidden and can corrupt those who discover them. They might be buried in the soil of a farmer's field, dropped into the depths of a village well, or stashed at the bottom of a toy box. Wherever the innocent might stumble across them and become unknowing actors in the decay of morality, the whispering remnant works its unholy magic.

A whispering remnant appears as a raw, decaying mass of flesh, fur, and gristle—a teratoma consisting of warty skin, sightless eyes, a finger or a toe, tufts of bristly hair, or teeth without mouths or lips to hide them. Each whispering remnant's shape is wildly different and uniquely unsettling. A whispering remnant automatically imparts to a PC the knowledge of how to use its Hear My Words activation as soon as it's touched, but its other activations must be discovered normally through the use of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} (and as normal, identifying the presence and effect of the curse it carries requires a critical success at such an attempt).

Unlike most cursed items, a character can discard a whispering remnant, yet doing so runs a real risk that it might thereafter fall into the wrong hands. In this Adventure Path, any whispering remnant the PCs discard anywhere other than the restored reliquary in the Maiserene Church at area A9 is discovered by one of the monsters of Bastardhall, who then Hides the horror somewhere in the region where it was found. Where the horror is hidden is left to you to decide.

As long as a creature carries a whispering remnant, its thoughts and dreams are influenced by cruel notions and temptations to commit violent depravities. A creature that's already predisposed toward these acts derives greater pleasure than before for such atrocities but receives no additional penalty or benefit, while a non-sapient creature is driven to become unnaturally violent in its actions (and over the course of weeks, becomes visibly corrupted by patches of strange fur, warty growths, unsightly teeth, or similar teratomas on its body). A sapient creature that isn't predisposed toward acts of depravity (likely including all PCs) takes a –9 item penalty to saving throws against all magical effects that attempt to encourage such acts. Saving throws against spells like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{Suggestion} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm} cast by creatures who attempt to push a PC into such acts, any affect by such creatures that attempts to control a PC, or certain specific effects mentioned in the text of this adventure would all be affected by this penalty. A creature with the holy trait reduces the overall item penalty imparted by this curse by 1, to a minimum penalty of 0.

A creature that's foolish enough to consume a whispering remnant becomes fused to its curse, at which point the whispering remnant remains lodged within the creature's body until the curse is removed from the creature with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} spell or similar magic, or upon the creature's death, whichever comes first. At this point, the whispering remnant crawls or oozes its way out of the creature's body and flops, once again inanimate, onto the ground, where it waits to be claimed by a new carrier.

As long as you carry a whispering remnant somewhere on your person, its curse does have a beneficial side: The power of its influence grants you a +3 item bonus to all saving throws against curses from other sources, as the whispering remnant jealously wards against such encroachments on its territory.

The whispering remnant periodically twitches and pulses as if it were alive.

Activate—Become As One 1 minute (concentrate, manipulate)

Effect By piling eight whispering remnants in a heap and then concentrating upon the mound of cursed flesh for a minute, you cause the eight whispering remnants to slither together and become a single whispering remnant. Once combined in this manner, the resulting whispering remnant cannot be thereafter split into individual whispering remnants.

Activate—Hear My Words 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect The whispering remnant casts a DC 23 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IihxWhRfpsBgQ5jS]{Enthrall} spell to your specifications. Creatures that fail or critically fail to resist this spell perceive and remember the whispering remnant in your hand as something commonplace to the region, such as a farming tool, book, or fresh-baked pie, for as long as they remain enthralled. If you don't take advantage of this to subtly guide any affected creatures toward undermining their society, the whispering remnant can't be activated to Hear My Words again by you for 1 week. Additionally, the next time you sleep, you endure horrific nightmares and must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:30] save upon waking to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 24 hours (this is a mental effect).

Activate—Hide the Horror 10 minutes (manipulate)

Frequency once per year

Effect You hide the whispering remnant somewhere that, in time, it is likely to be found. For the following four weeks, the whispering remnant's evil seeps into the surrounding landscape, expanding its influence at a rate of 500 feet per day until it reaches its maximum emanation of 14,000 feet after 28 days. It continues to influence this area for another three weeks before going dormant—it must be recovered and rehidden later once this activation recharges to begin the cycle again. While the remnant's influence is active, any sapient creature that sleeps in the area experiences unsettling dreams of being stalked by monsters they can never quite see or evade. A creature that doesn't worship an unholy deity who experiences these dreams must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:30] save each time they rest to avoid awakening @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}. On a critical failure, the creature awakens stupefied 1 as well; this condition remains until removed or until they are no longer fatigued, whichever comes first. Creatures who worship an unholy deity or follow a despicable philosophy are immune to this effect. Any skill checks made by such creatures when performing rituals performed in the affected area gain a +1 item bonus, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Uqj344bezBq3ESdq]{Nightmare} spells cast by them within the region have their save DCs increased by 1.

Activate—Hear My Whispers 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect The whispering remnant casts a DC 30 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GP3wewkQXEPrLxYj]{Subconscious Suggestion} spell to your specifications. If the target of the spell fails or critically fails to save against this, they perceive and remember the whispering remnant as being a commonplace item. If you don't suggest a course of action to the target that causes them to work at undermining their society, the whispering remnant shrieks horribly, but only in your mind—you take @Damage[10d6[mental]|traits:concentrate,manipulate] damage (@Check[will|dc:30|basic|traits:concentrate,manipulate] save), after which the whispering remnant cannot be activated again by you for 1 week.

Destruction A whispering remnant can't be destroyed, but a whispering remnant can be by hurling it into a powerful curse effect created by the deity associated with the remnant. This causes the whispering remnant to become reabsorbed into the deity's otherworldly body and often has potent side effects on the surrounding region. Disposing of a whispering remnant in the soul vortex of Bastardhall (area I) after Caydserris has been defeated not only destroys the whispering remnant but helps bring the Bastardhall Curse to an end.

All-Seeing Eye.description:
This glass eyeball is slightly uncanny due to the two brightly colored crystal irises it sports on opposing sides. It helps combatants see their foes even in the darkest of situations.

  • Armor You gain resistance 2 to damage from illusion effects.

  • Weapon (fortune) After you cast a light spell by Activating the eye, your own eyesight sharpens until the end of your next turn. If you fail the flat check to target a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} opponent with a Strike with the weapon, you can reroll it and take the new result.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light}.
All-Seeing Eye.name: All-Seeing Eye

Shield of Endurance.description:
这面钢盾（硬度8，HP32，BT16）上雕刻着一面坚不可摧的城墙。

启动—临时耐力（Temporary Endurance） 1 （专注）

频率 每日一次

需求 你的盾牌未破损

效果 你举起盾牌，它获得10点临时生命值，持续1分钟。
Shield of Endurance.name: 耐力之盾 Shield of Endurance

Illusionist's Hat.description:
The illusionist's hat appears as a tall, black hat with a wide brim and a colorful band around its base. Although popularly associated with themes of magic, this hat is more the province of the entertainer or even the charlatan than of a proper arcanist, and many wizards scoff at those who openly wear such items. You gain a +1 item bonus to Deception checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} and to Thievery checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ijZ0DDFpMkWqaShd]{Palm an Object}.

Activate—What's In My Hat? 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect With a flourish, you remove your hat and sweep it before you. The illusionist's hat casts a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} to your specifications, save that the creature created must be an animal. As long as you continue to hold your hat in one hand, you can Sustain this illusion as a free action. Unlike with most illusory creatures, you cannot use your actions to speak through the creature.
Illusionist's Hat.name: Illusionist's Hat

Archer's Bulwark.description: 这面压花钢制小圆盾（硬度4，HP12，BT6）经过特殊设计，不会妨碍弓箭手拉弓弦的那只手。当你用这面小圆盾举起盾牌时，其针对远程打击提供的AC环境加值提升至+2。此额外加值不适用于体型异常庞大的远程投射物（如巨石或弩炮矢）。
Archer's Bulwark.name: 射手舷墙 Archer's Bulwark

Corrosive Staff.description:
A sickly green liquid sloshes inside this hollow glass staff, carrying an acrid scent. While wielding the staff, you gain resistance 3 to acid damage.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.thAHF1zxNplLCJPO]{Caustic Blast}

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rnNGALRtsjspFTws]{Acidic Burst}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
Corrosive Staff.name: Corrosive Staff

Moonweave (Major).description: 你的护甲会以清冷的月光沐浴你的伤口。穿着此护甲时，每当你将要受到法术或魔法效果的治疗，你额外恢复@Damage[10[healing]]生命值。你从月织护甲获得的额外生命值仅在你从某个特定治疗法术或效果中首次恢复生命值时生效，因此一个在持续时间内重复治疗你的法术或效果只会在你首次被治疗时提供一次额外生命值恢复。
Moonweave (Major).name: 上等月织 Moonweave (Major)

Ryhasphinea's Hourglass.gmnote:
Each Arudora memento is unique in appearance, but all seven are approximately the same size. Carried by each of the cursed family members, these mementos have within them the power to unlock entire portions of Bastardhall from the ghostly cursed state the castle traditionally exists in.

Activate—Return Memento 3 (manipulate) You place the memento into the appropriate statue's clutches in the fountain located in area B3 of Bastardhall. The statue briefly animates to claim the memento, which turns to stone and becomes thereafter a permanent part of the statue, effectively destroying the memento while granting a boon to the party that persists for the remainder of this Adventure Path. When this cracked hourglass is Returned, the vaults (detailed in Chapter 8) are unlocked. Death's grasp on the PCs wanes—for the rest of this Adventure Path, the DCs for all recovery checks made by a dying PC are reduced by 2.

Activate Cast a Spell (add 1 action)

This carved iron cloud appears unfinished and full of spurs, blemishes, and other imperfections. When used as a catalyst to cast a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8M03UxGXjYyDFAoy]{Weapon Storm} spell, the caster's weapon propels them forward. Before choosing the spell's area, Stride up to twice your Speed. This movement must be in a straight line and doesn't trigger reactions. The spell is then cast from your new location.

This staff is carved of golden birchwood, and its roughly patterned surface resembles tree bark. While wielding the staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC against attempts to [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] you.

Bonebloom Rose.description:
Activate 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

A bonebloom rose appears as a blue-petaled rose, often found growing within the ribs of a skeleton buried in a grave under Pharasma's protection. These consumable items can also be crafted as any other item. When you activate a bonebloom rose, you inhale deeply from its petals while squeezing the stem hard enough that its thorns painfully (but otherwise harmlessly) pierce your flesh. The rose then withers and crumbles to dust, and you gain 40 temporary Hit Points for 1 hour. As long as you have at least 1 of these temporary Hit Points remaining (and they haven't been replaced by temporary Hit Points from a different source), your Strikes deal an additional 2 spirit damage to undead.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.dQfUsEqT87Ib7tpn]{Effect: Bonebloom Rose}
Bonebloom Rose.name: Bonebloom Rose

Echoing Theater.description:
Activate Cast a Spell

This small diorama is fashioned like a theater and filled with rough-carved wooden figurines. When used as a catalyst to cast a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WVc30DGbM7TRLLul]{Ghostly Tragedy} spell, the caster can record the reenactment for later viewing or showing at a different location. This recording lasts for 1 week, and creatures viewing the recording can attempt checks to investigate the event as if they'd been present when the spell was cast. The figurines in an active diorama slowly move in vague approximations of the recorded events until activated for viewing, upon which they crack in half and fall motionless.
Echoing Theater.name: Echoing Theater

Laboratory Coat.description:
这件米白色实验大衣是一件+1韧性滑溜探索者服装，拥有众多口袋和一条缝在上面的工具腰带，用以携带实用工具。它由一位热衷于危险实验的学者发明家设计。这件大衣赋予穿戴者在手艺检定上获得+2物品加值，并在实验出差错时提供一条逃生路线。

启动—快速逃脱（Quick Escape） 2 （专注，操作，传送）

频率 每日一次

效果 你按下魔法纽扣并念出口令，立即将自己以及你所穿戴和持有的任何物品从当前空间传送到20尺内你可见且无人占据的一处空间。
Laboratory Coat.name: 实验服 Laboratory Coat

Chapbook of Terrors (Greater).description:
This lurid pamphlet contains spooky tales about ghosts, monsters, and murderers, all illustrated in gruesome detail. The stories, fortunately, are only fictions… or are they?

Activate—Horrify 1 (concentrate, mental, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your next action is to Cast a prepared Spell with the fear trait, creatures frightened by the spell also take @Damage[2d6[persistent,mental]] damage as they dwell on your terrifying tale.

Possum's Play (Major).description:
Activate F (concentrate)

Trigger You would take damage from an attack or magical effect.

This innocuous little charm looks like nothing so much as a patch of coarse white or dark gray fur, usually made to resemble a lucky rabbit's foot or something else. When you activate the talisman, the triggering attack gains the nonlethal trait, and you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, feigning death. An illusion surrounds you, causing you to appear dead for up to 24 hours. Any creature that touches the illusion or uses the [[/act seek]] action to examine you can attempt to disbelieve the illusion. The DC to disbelieve the illusion is 34. Any action requiring you to move or make noise immediately ends the illusion.
Possum's Play (Major).name: Possum's Play (Major)

Soulheart (Greater).description:
A soulheart is a crystallized sphere of red ectoplasm about the size of a human eye. When held by a living creature, a faint red light shimmers within the crystal, pulsating in a synchronized beat with the creature's heartbeat and providing illumination equivalent to that of a candle.

Activate—Bolster Life 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect When held to the chest and focused upon, the soul energy within the soulheart floods outward and bolsters your life force, granting you 12 temporary Hit Points (or 6 temporary Hit Points if it's nighttime). These temporary Hit Points last for 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.iiQSTRA8EVCvlfDQ]{Effect: Bolster Life}

Activate—Bolster Maiserene Phantom 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Effect When touched to a rank 1 Maiserene phantom, the soulheart flashes with bright red light and is destroyed. As it does so, it permanently increases the targeted phantom to rank 2, and increases each PC's maximum Hit Points by 2 for as long as they remain within Bastardhall while the castle remains cursed.

Destruction A soulheart is destroyed when it is activated to Bolster Maiserene Phantom.
Soulheart (Greater).name: Soulheart (Greater)

Activate Cast a Spell (add 1 action)

This ornate cryptex, made of bronze or similar metals, spins slowly until activated. When used as a catalyst to cast an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PERUlvKPtF7dMzN4]{Imaginary Lockbox} spell, the cryptex turns to generate a random release phrase before crumbling to dust and placing the magical lockbox in your mind. Items from the lockbox can be retrieved by anyone adjacent to you with whom you've shared the release phrase with.

Energizing Vial (Greater).description:
This sealed glass vial has no stopper and is filled with pure white light. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by Activating this item is [[/r 1d20+21 #spell attack roll]]{+21} and the spell DC is 31.

  • Armor After you cast an electricity spell by Activating the energizing vial, you can Step as a free action once per round until the end of your next turn.

  • Weapon After you cast an electricity spell by Activating the energizing vial, your Strikes with the weapon deal @Damage[1d6[persistent,electricity]] damage until the end of your next turn.

Energizing Vial (Greater).name: Energizing Vial (Greater)

Mirrorblade.description:
这把+2高等强击锋锐镰剑由近乎无瑕的反光材料打造，使其表面闪烁着迷人的光泽。

启动—幻影守卫（Mirage Guard） 1 （专注，操作）

频率 每日一次

效果 你挥动镜刃在头顶旋转，制造出围绕自身的幻象扭曲，使对手难以判断你的真实位置。在接下来的10分钟内，你不会因被夹击而陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]。

启动—防护探知（Scryshield） 2 （专注）

频率 每日一次

效果 镜刃的反光表面变得暗淡，你和你的所有物品被一层闪烁的力场所包围，使你在1小时内对探知魔法隐形。此外，你还会得知@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]范围内任何探知效果（如同侦测探知）。如果你将镜刃收入鞘中、投掷或用来攻击，此效果提前结束。
Mirrorblade.name: 镜刃 Mirrorblade

Literate Lemur.description:
Activate Cast a Spell

This carved effigy of a lemur clutches a pen and paper, its expression cackling gleefully. When used as a catalyst to cast a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tFKJCPvOQZxKq6ON]{Mad Monkeys} spell, the following option is added to the options normally available.

  • Fierce Debate The monkeys appear frantically scribbling on conjured paper before turning on each other in a fit of rage; those who can speak with animals understand the dispute to be broadly over prose, spelling, and grammar. Creatures in the spell's area are met with a flurry of paper and fur as the resulting fracas obstructs their sight. When the spell ends, paper and pens conjured by this spell disappear.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.
Literate Lemur.name: Literate Lemur

Birchstaff (Major).description:
This staff is carved of golden birchwood, and its roughly patterned surface resembles tree bark. While wielding the staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC against attempts to [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] you.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9I8mp7RkjeXbkYfx]{Timber}

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K9gI08enGtmih5X1]{Protector Tree}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IHjiWCouSacC5b3g]{Wooden Fists}

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcYCWMd1NVCJ5Zbu]{Helpful Wood Spirits}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Bc6QqTmFV4q7G7L0]{Splinter Volley}

  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5XUn9NADr05IyiVw]{Soothing Blossoms}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aUMmmtPmBdCdVDed]{Wooden Double}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IHjiWCouSacC5b3g]{Wooden Fists}

  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HTzrWoYokIEqxD9t]{Blood Chestnuts}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FHfrCABOmGVaEpPx]{Life-Draining Roots}

  • 5th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VDK5cQ94BszDrMiJ]{Entwined Roots}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GnAuGxu72vCIQH2P]{Tree of Life and Death}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
Birchstaff (Major).name: Birchstaff (Major)

Crystal Lattice.description:
这件+2韧性衣装探险者服装是一件长款马甲，由灵活耐用的细密晶格构成。此类马甲种类繁多，颜色取决于构成晶格的晶体类型。当敌人击中穿戴者时，晶体会短暂发光。

启动—水晶外骨骼（Crystal Exoskeleton） 2 （专注，操作）

频率 每日一次

效果 你马甲上的晶格生长延伸，形成一件结构精巧的外骨骼覆盖全身。你获得20点临时生命值，持续1小时。当临时生命值耗尽或持续时间结束时，外骨骼化为尘埃，晶体恢复原状。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.jScKhgTHvI9leZV3]
Crystal Lattice.name: 晶格马甲 Crystal Lattice

Spiral Labyrinth.description:
Action F (concentrate)

Trigger You Shield Block an attack with the affixed shield.

This talisman takes the form of an oddly textured piece of parchment, depicting a spiraling labyrinth around a central point. When you activate the labyrinth, part of the weapon or arrow striking you seems to vanish into the paper and reemerge at an unexpected angle or impossible distance. Increase the shield's Hardness by 10 for the Shield Block. The amount of damage your shield blocks is reflected onto a target you choose within 15 feet with a @Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] save.
Spiral Labyrinth.name: Spiral Labyrinth

Flame Layer Balm.description:
启动 3 （操作）

将这种赤金色香膏厚厚涂覆于一套盔甲之上，会呈现出火焰舔舐般的旋卷纹路。香膏在盔甲上留存1小时，在此期间，穿戴者首次受到火焰伤害时，香膏会轰然迸发为烈焰，穿戴者获得法术@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XS7Wyh5YC0NWeWyB]的效果，持续1分钟。
Flame Layer Balm.name: 焰纹香膏 Flame Layer Balm

Helping Hand (Greater).description:
This miniature wooden hand has fully articulated fingers with brass joints. The tiny hand twitches infrequently of its own accord, especially if scrutinized for too long.

  • Armor You increase your maximum and encumbered Bulk limit by 2.

  • Weapon You gain a +2 item bonus to skill checks to Aid when wielding the weapon.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.mMjWrkt5usgrvik8]{Effect: Helping Hand - Armor}

Ice Gliders.description:
These ornately embroidered boots are crafted by Varki artisans to help their hunters and warriors as they cross back and forth over the snow and ice of their homelands. Empowered by the magic woven into them, these boots enable their wearer to ignore any uneven ground or difficult terrain caused by snow and ice. Additionally, while Striding on ice, you can move 10 feet for every 5 feet of movement you spend, as icy blades grow from the boots.

Activate—Rough Ice 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You stomp your foot on the ground, creating a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] of jagged ice on the ground that lasts for 1 minute before melting. This ice is difficult terrain.
Ice Gliders.name: Ice Gliders

Chained Mist.description:
这件+1韧性高等暗影朝银链甲衫由标准品质朝银制成，雾气在其周围盘旋缭绕。穿着时，银色气雾拖曳出的轨迹与暗影细丝相互交织，如活物般缀于周身，随穿戴者的四肢与躯干一同舞动。若穿戴者处于昏暗光照中，雾气会遮蔽其身形，使其获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]状态。

启动—迷雾织网（Misty Mesh） 1 （专注，操作）

频率 每日一次

效果 雾气立即凝固成一层银链防护网，使你获得10点精魂抗力，持续1分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.F3MrepdLPMZ2lbEc]
Chained Mist.name: 雾锁链甲 Chained Mist

Energy Shield Tunic.description:
这件光滑、可变色的束腰外衣拥有比大多数衣物更高的纱线密度。它是一件+2高等韧性探险者服装，能帮助穿戴者抵御强大的能量魔法。在你进行每日准备时，从下列能量类型中选择一种：酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰或音波。你对所选能量类型获得10点抗力，持续至你的下一次每日准备。束腰外衣会根据所选能量类型改变颜色并添加主题刺绣。

  • 酸蚀 束腰外衣变为棕色，并用亮绿色丝线绣出飞溅的酸液图案。

  • 寒冷 束腰外衣变为天蓝色，并用银色丝线绣出雪花图案。

  • 电击 束腰外衣变为深灰色，并用浅蓝色丝线绣出闪电图案。

  • 火焰 束腰外衣变为橙色，并用红色和黄色丝线绣出火球图案。

  • 音波 束腰外衣变为白色，并用金色丝线绣出音符图案。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.7NImqTYZ5Yg9gkM3]

启动—防护指令（Shielding Command） r （幸运，操作）

频率 每日一次

触发 你即将对一个会造成酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰或音波伤害的法术进行豁免检定，但尚未掷骰

效果 将触发的豁免检定掷两次，取较好的结果。
Energy Shield Tunic.name: 能量防护服 Energy Shield Tunic

Possum's Play.description:
Activate F (concentrate)

Trigger You would take damage from an attack or magical effect.

This innocuous little charm looks like nothing so much as a patch of coarse white or dark gray fur, usually made to resemble a lucky rabbit's foot or something else. When you activate the talisman, the triggering attack gains the nonlethal trait, and you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, feigning death. An illusion surrounds you, causing you to appear dead for up to 1 minute. Any creature that touches the illusion or uses the [[/act seek]] action to examine you can attempt to disbelieve the illusion. The DC to disbelieve the illusion is 18. Any action requiring you to move or make noise immediately ends the illusion.
Possum's Play.name: Possum's Play

Poet's Fritter (Greater).description:
The flavor of the cinnamon apple pastry called a poet's fritter is more than delicious—it inspires the tongue to great acts of spoken eloquence. When eaten, a poet's fritter not only bolsters your knack at telling stories and entertaining with your voice, it also fills your thoughts with the ability to swiftly and adroitly defend your mind from unpleasant mental agonies. For 1 hour, you gain a +3 item bonus to Deception checks to Lie and to Performance checks made for vocal-based performances, and resistance 15 against mental damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.gpsTtIhD8wk2MwbW]{Effect: Poet's Fritter}
Poet's Fritter (Greater).name: Poet's Fritter (Greater)

Lockpicker's Oil (Greater).description:
启动 1 （操作）

将这种澄澈的黄色油液涂在锁上可以让撬锁事半功倍。在接下来的1分钟内，任何尝试开锁的人在贼活检定上都会获得+2状态加值。此外，在此期间，若任何人的贼活检定首次掷出大失败，将其改为失败。这小瓶的量仅够用于一把锁。
Lockpicker's Oil (Greater).name: 高等撬锁油 Lockpicker's Oil (Greater)

Coward's Shield.description:
这面诡异的黑色钢盾（硬度6，HP36，BT18）似乎会主动排斥触及它的光线。当你举起盾牌时，你在用于[[/act hide]]的隐秘检定上获得+1环境加值。

启动—阴影滑落（Shadow Slip） f （专注）

频率 每日一次

触发 你在此盾举起状态下即将受到伤害

效果 阴影吞没了你。你变得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]，持续到你下个回合结束。
Coward's Shield.name: 懦夫之盾 Coward's Shield

Mobile.description: 蚀刻此符文的护甲能使你步履轻盈。每回合一次，你在快步时能额外移动5尺。
Mobile.name: 机动 Mobile

Continuum Staff.description:
A looped band of copper, winding in on itself, sits atop the head of this shiny metal staff. The staff's surface seems to warp unpredictably when viewed, the reflections across the shiny surface of its length never forming the same pattern twice.

Activate—Restitch Time r (fortune, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You would fail or critically fail an attack roll, saving throw, or skill check

Effect You briefly reverse time to fix your error. Reroll the triggering check, taking the better of the two results.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sX2g6WFSQPNW9jzx]{Warp Step}

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rerNA6YZsdxuJYt3]{Déjà Vu}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DgcSiOCR1uDXGaEA]{Synchronize}

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gC3oEJ4WByq1LRO8]{Unrelenting Gravity}

  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.94IYF1lHbki390VN]{Inertia Lock}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qJGW6BbIcU6sfA1d]{Time Jump}

  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zR67Rt3UMHKC5evy]{Flicker}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gC3oEJ4WByq1LRO8]{Unrelenting Gravity}

  • 5th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5tpk4Q2QI3FVhm99]{Rewinding Step}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.CVyAG7mXrs868UyB]{Space Fold Gate}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate}

  • 6th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OdqM06M0wDUqZWiR]{Cast into Time}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3XygMbzrZMgV1y3]{Collective Transposition}

  • 7th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.29tJyuEfFP43lMcM]{Infinitesimal Collapse Field}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.CVyAG7mXrs868UyB]{Space Fold Gate}
