Corrosive Staff (Major).description:
A sickly green liquid sloshes inside this hollow glass staff, carrying an acrid scent. While wielding the staff, you gain resistance 9 to acid damage.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.thAHF1zxNplLCJPO]{Caustic Blast}

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rnNGALRtsjspFTws]{Acidic Burst}

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9h9YCncqah6VNsKf]{Acid Grip}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NWIDE4XKtL3Nb4pO]{Disintegrating Puddle}

  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rnNGALRtsjspFTws]{Acidic Burst}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3A3ueS9Q0s3U8KXE]{Noxious Metals}

  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9h9YCncqah6VNsKf]{Acid Grip,} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NWIDE4XKtL3Nb4pO]{Disintegrating Puddle}

  • 5th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZW8ovbu1etdfMre3]{Acid Storm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.59NR1hA2jPSgg2sW]{Blister}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BlfOg9Ceymgjstjm]{Corrosive Muck}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
Corrosive Staff (Major).name: Corrosive Staff (Major)

Guiding Starknife.description:
这把+1强击回力星刃由深蓝色金属制成，表面覆有烟灰色熔融石英斑点。当你施放法术并造成伤害时，你本回合结束前使用此星刃进行的下一次攻击忽略标准掩蔽和次等掩蔽。

启动—光点（Points of Light） r （专注，精魂）

频率 每10分钟一次

触发 你使用指引星刃以投掷打击成功命中一个生物

效果 指引星刃的刀片分离，化为星光飞镖，对你刚命中的生物造成@Damage[4[piercing],1d4[spirit]]伤害。若星刃带有高等强击符文，此穿刺伤害提升至@Damage[6[piercing],1d4[spirit]]；若带有上等强击符文，则提升至@Damage[8[piercing],1d4[spirit]]。随后指引星刃重新成形并返回你手中。直到你下回合开始，受伤害的生物被柔和光线勾勒，无法获得隐蔽的效果。
Guiding Starknife.name: 指引星刃 Guiding Starknife

Thirsty Chalice.description:
This slate chalice improbably holds one single drop of water in it at all times and helps refresh the wearer, sometimes at the expense of their enemies.

  • Armor After you cast a spell by Activating the chalice, you are surrounded by a fine mist. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} until the beginning of your next turn.

  • Weapon (void) After you cast a spell by Activating the chalice, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional @Damage[1[void]] damage until the end of your next turn; the first time in a round you successfully deal this void damage, you gain 4 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.fUm1q1yCidJjoOxg]{Effect: Thirsty Chalice - Weapon}

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lXsFKdaOz9t9w11U]{Draw Moisture}.
Thirsty Chalice.name: Thirsty Chalice

Debilitating Dart.name: 衰弱飞镖 Debilitating Dart
Debilitating Dart.description: 这把+1强击回力飞镖由黑钢锻造而成，其上蚀刻的符文闪烁着虹彩光泽。被此飞镖击中并造成伤害的生物，在1轮内对其下一次对抗魔法效果的豁免检定承受–2状态减值。随后该目标对此效果免疫24小时。

Sidestepping.description:
蚀刻了此符文的一套护甲能使穿戴者的形体轻微振动，与世界其余部分产生相移，让其不可思议地穿过固体。

启动—相位穿行（Phase Through） 1

频率 每日一次

效果 直到你当前回合结束，你可以穿过非魔法固体表面。将任何穿过比空气更厚物品的移动视为困难地形。当持续时间结束时，如果你正与一个固体物品共享空间，你会被推到最近的未被占据的空间，并承受@Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]]伤害。
Sidestepping.name: 避障 Sidestepping

Safeguarding.description:
你的护甲覆有一层由粉色、青绿色与蓝色能量构成的闪烁拼花，保护你重要的方方面面。启动时，护甲的色调会根据你获得的抗力类型而变化：青绿色（心灵）、蓝色（毒素）或粉色（精魂）。

启动—适应护盾（Adaptive Aegis） r （专注）

频率 每日一次

触发 你将受到心灵、毒素或精魂伤害

效果 你获得针对触发伤害类型的5点抗力，持续10分钟。
Safeguarding.name: 保全 Safeguarding

Fey Staff.description:
Vines twine around this wooden staff, carved with silhouettes of pixies and nymphs. Some fey staves have the symbol of an Eldest inlaid in silver on their surfaces. While wielding the staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception and Diplomacy checks against creatures with the fey trait.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic}

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hs7h8f4Z1ZNdUt3s]{Summon Fey}

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.J6vNvrUT3b1hx2iA]{Entangling Flora}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hs7h8f4Z1ZNdUt3s]{Summon Fey}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
Fey Staff.name: Fey Staff

Blessed Lantern Flail.description:
这把+2强击圣洁链枷兼具带罩提灯与钝击武器的功能，持用时会在半径30尺范围内发出明亮光照，并在接下来30尺范围内发出昏暗光照。提灯的光亮无法被非魔法手段熄灭。据说第一位神圣链灯锤是由一位开明的守墓人打造的。

启动—净化邪法（Purge Unholy Magic） 1 （专注）

频率 每10分钟一次

效果 你使用链枷暂时扰乱邪秽施法者与其魔法的连接。对一名拥有内在法术或准备法术的邪秽生物进行近战打击。若命中并造成伤害，目标必须尝试@Check[will|dc:31]豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 直到你下回合开始，该生物施放法术时必须成功通过@Check[flat|dc:5]检定。

失败 如同成功，但效果持续1分钟。

大失败 如同失败，但纯骰检定的DC为11。
Blessed Lantern Flail.name: 神圣链灯锤 Blessed Lantern Flail

Bloodstained Treatise.description:
The white leather cover of this book is splotched with rusty red bloodstains, and its pages seep red when turned, although this never stains the bearer's hands or clothing. Anatomical drawings illustrate its pages.

Activate—Sanguine Expulsion 1 (concentrate, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your next action is to Cast a prepared Spell that manipulates blood, such as blood vendetta or vampiric exsanguination, or a spell dealing piercing or slashing damage, all targets of the triggering spell take @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]|options:area-damage] damage; if the spell already causes bleed damage, the bleed damage increases by 1d6. The wounds of one affected target (chosen by you) gush uncontrollably, covering the ground with blood in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] that lasts for 1 round. Creatures that begin their turn in the blood must succeed at a Reflex save against your spell DC or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
Bloodstained Treatise.name: Bloodstained Treatise

Gravebane Ammunition (Greater).description:
Ammunition any

Activate 1 (manipulate)

First made to deal with a wicked necromancer's encroaching horde, gravebane ammunition is crafted with materials soaked in blessed waters. On a successful Strike, the attack deals an additional @Damage[2d10[vitality]] damage to creatures with void healing. If the target takes vitality damage, it must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} on a critical failure) until the start of your next turn.
Gravebane Ammunition (Greater).name: Gravebane Ammunition (Greater)

Golden-Souled Yang Na.description:
Prerequisites worshipper of a deity or pantheon

The traditions of these large tattoos, often stretching over the back or shoulders, have been passed from Tang Mai's tree-keeping priests to their students across Tian Xia.

Activate—Soul Blessing f (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You take an action with the rage, stance, or tandem trait

Effect The tattoo purifies your mind and body, reducing your clumsy, enfeebled, frightened, or stupefied condition by 1.

Special While you are under the effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ah5g9pDwWF9b9VW9]{Rage}, the Soul Blessing action gains the rage trait.
Golden-Souled Yang Na.name: Golden-Souled Yang Na

Escalation Ammunition.description:
Ammunition any

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Malevolent arcane energy leaks from within escalation ammunition, sizzling with barely @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} contempt. When activated escalation ammunition hits a target, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save. On a failure, the target rolls the next saving throw it attempts within the next minute against a spell or magical effect twice and takes the worse result.
Escalation Ammunition.name: Escalation Ammunition

Disruption Ammunition (Greater).description:
Ammunition any

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Disruption ammunition consists of alchemically treated metal, the surface of which roils like the thrashings of a writhing parasite trapped within. When activated disruption ammunition hits a target, it attempts to counteract one active spell effect that the target is Sustaining with a +20 counteract check modifier (counteract rank 6).
Disruption Ammunition (Greater).name: Disruption Ammunition (Greater)

Spellshock Shield.description:
这面中等强固钢盾（硬度10，HP92，BT46）镶嵌着锯齿状的晶脉，嗡嗡作响地储存着能量。

启动—噼啪电弧（Crackling Arc） r （专注，电击，操作）

频率 每日一次

触发 你在举起震法盾时，对一项魔法效果的反射豁免成功

效果 一道不稳定的锯齿状能量束射向120尺内的一个生物，造成@Damage[4d12[electricity]]伤害（@Check[reflex|dc:28|basic]豁免）。
Spellshock Shield.name: 震法盾 Spellshock Shield

Graverose Garland.description:
This long, scarf-like garment appears to be made of living vines on which a dozen black roses bloom. While the vines appear to be thorny, they lack the capability to puncture or scratch, allowing the garland to be worn comfortably as a scarf or belt. The scent of the black roses evokes faint feelings of melancholy and nostalgia to the living, but undead find the odor to be unnerving and distracting. As long as you have a graverose garland invested, it grants a +1 item bonus to Deception and Intimidation checks against undead.

Activate—To the Grave with You! 2 (emotion, fear, manipulation, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You lift some of the garland to your lips and blow, sending the scent of the black roses outward to target an undead creature you can see within 60 feet. The targeted undead becomes filled with the conviction that it belongs in its grave, and it must attempt a @Check[will|dc:19|options:inflicts:off-guard,inflicts:prone,inflicts:frightened,inflicts:fleeing|traits:emotion,fear,manipulation,mental] save against the following effects.

Critical Success The undead creature is unaffected.

Success The undead creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The undead creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and is off-guard as long as it remains frightened.

Critical Failure As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}, and the undead is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} as long as it remains frightened. If the undead knows of a nearby empty grave, it must flee toward that grave—if it enters the grave, it drops @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} into the grave and remains prone until it is no longer frightened.
Graverose Garland.name: Graverose Garland

Convincing.description: 服众符文会融入你护甲的装饰元素中，例如浮雕图案和彩色饰物。穿戴此护甲时，你在[[/act make-an-impression]]和请求的交涉检定中获得+1物品加值。
Convincing.name: 服众 Convincing

Accoutrements of Bone.description:
这件+1韧性探险者服装内衬着经过魔法强化的雕骨，由强化肌腱连接，为穿着者提供舒适与灵活性。肩部和前臂护具上伸出各种形状和大小的尖刺与棘刺。当你穿着这套服装时，你在神秘检定中获得+2物品加值。

启动—复仇穿刺（Piercing Vengeance） r （专注，操作）

频率 每日一次

触发 一名敌人用近战打击对你造成伤害

效果 你服装上的锯齿状尖刺射向触发的敌人，造成@Damage[6d6[piercing]]伤害，@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic]豁免。
Accoutrements of Bone.name: 骸骨军装 Accoutrements of Bone

Jinnivere's Riding Crop.name: Jinnivere's Riding Crop
Jinnivere's Riding Crop.gmnote:
Each Arudora memento is unique in appearance, but all seven are approximately the same size. Carried by each of the cursed family members, these mementos have within them the power to unlock entire portions of Bastardhall from the ghostly cursed state the castle traditionally exists in.

Activate—Return Memento 3 (manipulate) You place the memento into the appropriate statue's clutches in the fountain located in area B3 of Bastardhall. The statue briefly animates to claim the memento, which turns to stone and becomes thereafter a permanent part of the statue, effectively destroying the memento while granting a boon to the party that persists for the remainder of this Adventure Path. When this leather riding crop is Returned, the cellars (detailed in Chapter 3) are unlocked. Companions are now more hearty and full of life—PC companions (such as familiars, eidolons, and animal companions) gain a +1 status bonus to all saving throws for the remainder of this Adventure Path.

Destruction An Arudora memento is destroyed when it's activated with Return Memento, and the boon it grants upon this returning lasts until the very end of the Adventure Path.

Phantom Fang.description:
This +1 standard-grade cold iron kama is shrouded in spectral mist, leaving behind shimmering afterimages when swung.

Activate—Phantom Dodge r

Frequency once per day

Trigger You're targeted by a ranged attack, and you're aware of the attacker

Effect Your body becomes temporarily shrouded in mist, causing you to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} against the triggering attack.
Phantom Fang.name: Phantom Fang

Runeveil Ammunition.description:
Ammunition any

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Pulsing, cracked glyphs scar the surface of runeveil ammunition, seeming to flake and crumble when handled roughly. When activated runeveil ammunition hits a target that can Cast Spells, it's engulfed in a personal cloud of glowing dust. Until the beginning of your next turn, the target takes a –2 status penalty to spell attack rolls and spell DCs.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.qIU22bx5I6d6peRW]{Effect: Runeveil Ammunition}
Runeveil Ammunition.name: Runeveil Ammunition

Wormhole Shot.description:
Ammunition arrow, bolt

Activate 1 (manipulate)

The shaft of a wormhole shot gleams like polished ebony and seems to be not quite straight; nevertheless, this ammunition flies true. When an activated wormhole shot hits a target, which can be an unoccupied square, it embeds itself and remains active for up to 1 minute. A creature can Interact to dislodge the ammunition, but it remains active unless the creature spends another Interact action to destroy it.

Once during the wormhole shot's duration, if you're within 60 feet of it, you can use it as the point of origin for a spell or ranged attack, calculating range and cover from whatever space the wormhole shot is in. After being used this way, it quickly dissolves into black dust.
Wormhole Shot.name: Wormhole Shot

Thirsty Chalice (Greater).description:
This slate chalice improbably holds one single drop of water in it at all times and helps refresh the wearer, sometimes at the expense of their enemies. The DC of all spells cast by Activating this item is 22.

  • Armor After you cast a spell by Activating the chalice, you are surrounded by a fine mist. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} until the beginning of your next turn.

  • Weapon (void) After you cast a spell by Activating the chalice, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional @Damage[2[void]] damage until the end of your next turn; the first time in a round you successfully deal this void damage, you gain 8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.fUm1q1yCidJjoOxg]{Effect: Thirsty Chalice - Weapon}

@Check[fortitude|dc:22|basic|name:Thirsty Chalice Spell|traits:spell|showDC:all]

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lXsFKdaOz9t9w11U]{Draw Moisture}.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

Effect Y ou cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.B3eLlbaPxOYHcs1o]{Curse of Lost Time}.
Thirsty Chalice (Greater).name: Thirsty Chalice (Greater)

Calamity's Bane Tattoo.description:
This small tattoo of a stylized lidded or clouded eye radiating lines of power is inked on a part of your body that you cannot easily see with your own eyes, such as the nape of your neck, behind your ears, or your interscapular region. This tattoo protects you during calamity as well as uncertainty, guiding your intuition to take subconscious actions and precautions to shelter you in a thousand unknown ways. When you are affected by a misfortune effect or a curse, your shrouded eye tattoo emits an intense sensation akin to pins and needles, alerting you that something is awry, though the specific nature of the danger might be unknown to you.

Activate—Alleviate Uncertainty f (concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You make a check for an action that has the secret trait or that has been affected by a misfortune effect

Effect You gain a +1 status bonus to the check associated with the triggering action.
Calamity's Bane Tattoo.name: Calamity's Bane Tattoo

Verdant Leaves (Major).description:
The pages of this book are dried leaves in all colors of the seasons, their delicate veins spelling out incantations. It carries the earthy scent of a forest floor.

Activate—Nature's Resilience 1 (concentrate, plant, wood)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your last action was to Cast a prepared Spell with the plant or wood trait, you imbue yourself with the strength of the natural world and obtain the effect of a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YWrfKetOqDwVFut7]{Oaken Resilience} spell.
Verdant Leaves (Major).name: Verdant Leaves (Major)

Energy Vulnerability (Greater).description: 铭刻了此符文的武器会呈现出与创造符文时所选能量类型相对应颜色的光泽：绿色（酸蚀）、蓝色（寒冷）、白色（电击）、橙色（火焰）或黄色（音波）。当你用带有此符文的武器重击一个目标时，目标获得对所选能量类型的弱点10，持续至你的下一回合结束。该弱点不与目标已拥有的任何该能量类型的弱点叠加，且不影响对该能量类型具有免疫或抗力的生物。
Energy Vulnerability (Greater).name: 高等能量弱点 Energy Vulnerability (Greater)

Cerebral Barbell (Major).description:
This tiny metallic barbell is strangely heavy for its size. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by Activating this item is [[/r 1d20+19 #spell attack roll]]{+19} and the DC of any spell cast by Activating this item is 29.

  • Armor You gain resistance 2 to force.

  • Weapon After casting a spell by Activating the cerebral barbell, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional @Damage[4[force]] damage until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.9BRjMqkdKSC723aQ]{Effect: Cerebral Barbell - Armor}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.zXoezc8AxZkh0aFB]{Effect: Cerebral Barbell - Weapon}

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.60sgbuMWN0268dB7]{Telekinetic Projectile}.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NIXXJoGuzvctynBt]{Iron Rain}.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5SDKyUShSMbv0Vh1]{Magnetize}.
Cerebral Barbell (Major).name: Cerebral Barbell (Major)

Hundred Stings.description:
Activate Cast a Spell

Golden bee-shaped charms with deceptively sharp stingers feature along the length of this gold chain, which often draws blood when handled improperly. When used as a catalyst to cast an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WqPhJNzLa8vSjrH6]{Animated Assault} spell, you can change the damage type to piercing.
Hundred Stings.name: Hundred Stings

This tiny metallic barbell is strangely heavy for its size. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by Activating this item is [[/r 1d20+7 #spell attack roll]]{+7}.

Cerebral Barbell.name: Cerebral Barbell

Silver Tongue.description:
This tongue-shaped silver trinket typically dangles from a silver chain. It seems to catch the light wherever it is affixed. When affixed to armor or a weapon with any metal components, it makes those pieces gleam brightly. The spell DC of any spell cast by Activating this item is 24.

  • Armor You gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against auditory and linguistic effects.

  • Weapon After you cast a mental spell by Activating the silver tongue, you gain a +2 item bonus to Intimidation checks to [[/act demoralize]] until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.mdd1uz3QikAEp3Z8]{Effect: Silver Tongue - Armor}

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4gBIw4IDrSfFHik4]{Daze}.
Silver Tongue.name: Silver Tongue

Dazerien's Thumbscrew.name: Dazerien's Thumbscrew
Dazerien's Thumbscrew.gmnote:
Each Arudora memento is unique in appearance, but all seven are approximately the same size. Carried by each of the cursed family members, these mementos have within them the power to unlock entire portions of Bastardhall from the ghostly cursed state the castle traditionally exists in.

Activate—Return Memento 3 (manipulate) You place the memento into the appropriate statue's clutches in the fountain located in area B3 of Bastardhall. The statue briefly animates to claim the memento, which turns to stone and becomes thereafter a permanent part of the statue, effectively destroying the memento while granting a boon to the party that persists for the remainder of this Adventure Path. When this gory bronze thumbscrew is Returned, the private halls (detailed in Chapter 6) are unlocked. Rest becomes more rewarding now that the sadist of the dungeon has been defeated. For the rest of the Adventure Path, when the PCs take their 8-hour period of rest, they recover an additional number of Hit Points equal to their Constitution modifier (minimum 1) times their level.

Destruction An Arudora memento is destroyed when it's activated with Return Memento, and the boon it grants upon this returning lasts until the very end of the Adventure Path.

Three Bird Pinion.description:
Activate 1 (concentrate)

This talisman is made using the interlocking feathers gathered from at least three kinds of birds, carefully trimmed into a circle. When you activate this talisman, you become lighter than air, causing you to levitate 1 foot off the ground for 1 minute. While levitated this way, you can still move as normal, but you ignore most difficult, greater difficult, and hazardous terrain on the ground.
Three Bird Pinion.name: Three Bird Pinion

Verdant Leaves (Greater).description:
The pages of this book are dried leaves in all colors of the seasons, their delicate veins spelling out incantations. It carries the earthy scent of a forest floor.

Activate—Nature's Resilience 1 (concentrate, plant, wood)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your last action was to Cast a prepared Spell with the plant or wood trait, you imbue yourself with the strength of the natural world and obtain the effect of a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YWrfKetOqDwVFut7]{Oaken Resilience} spell.
Verdant Leaves (Greater).name: Verdant Leaves (Greater)

Cheery Chime (Major).description:
This single crystalline wind chime occasionally jingles as if blown against another chime by a soothing breeze. The spell DC of any spell cast by Activating the item is 34.

  • Armor You gain a +3 item bonus to saving throws against emotion effects.

  • Weapon After you cast an emotion spell by Activating the cheery chime, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional @Damage[1d8[mental]] damage until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.51keeuqkDG49wZ1W]{Effect: Cheery Chime - Armor}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.Zlic4FK23xUjUR0i]{Effect: Cheery Chime - Weapon}

Energizing Vial.description:
This sealed glass vial has no stopper and is filled with pure white light. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by Activating this item is [[/r 1d20+13 #spell attack roll]]{+13}.

  • Armor After you cast an electricity spell by Activating the energizing vial, you can Step as a free action once per round until the end of your next turn.

  • Weapon After you cast an electricity spell by Activating the energizing vial, your Strikes with the weapon deal @Damage[1d4[persistent,electricity]] damage until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.UPeHUz2pBR3cd980]{Effect: Energizing Vial - Weapon}

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Vbj8bTQ1nwrOBbYF]{Live Wire}
Energizing Vial.name: Energizing Vial

Calligraphic Illumination.description:
An ever-shifting series of calligraphic runes scrawls across the pages of this leather-bound book, as if written by an unseen hand. Calligraphic illuminations are sacred to the faith of Irez, Lady of Inscribed Wonder.

Activate—Inscribed Insight f (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your last action was to Cast a prepared Spell that creates or manipulates written text or runes, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EE7Q5BHIrfWNCPtT]{Runic Body}, the writing briefly forms into words conveying valuable information. Attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about any one creature or object that you can see with a +2 item bonus to the check.
Calligraphic Illumination.name: Calligraphic Illumination

Raudltz's Telescope.name: Raudltz's Telescope
Raudltz's Telescope.gmnote:
Each Arudora memento is unique in appearance, but all seven are approximately the same size. Carried by each of the cursed family members, these mementos have within them the power to unlock entire portions of Bastardhall from the ghostly cursed state the castle traditionally exists in.

Activate—Return Memento 3 (manipulate) You place the memento into the appropriate statue's clutches in the fountain located in area B3 of Bastardhall. The statue briefly animates to claim the memento, which turns to stone and becomes thereafter a permanent part of the statue, effectively destroying the memento while granting a boon to the party that persists for the remainder of this Adventure Path. When this handheld telescope is Returned, the fallen temple (detailed in Chapter 7) is unlocked. Secrets are now more difficult to hide in Bastardhall. Reduce all Perception DCs made when Seeking or Searching by 2 for the rest of this Adventure Path.

Destruction An Arudora memento is destroyed when it's activated with Return Memento, and the boon it grants upon this returning lasts until the very end of the Adventure Path.

Poet's Fritter (Moderate).description:
The flavor of the cinnamon apple pastry called a poet's fritter is more than delicious—it inspires the tongue to great acts of spoken eloquence. When eaten, a poet's fritter not only bolsters your knack at telling stories and entertaining with your voice, it also fills your thoughts with the ability to swiftly and adroitly defend your mind from unpleasant mental agonies. For 1 hour, you gain a +2 item bonus to Deception checks to Lie and to Performance checks made for vocal-based performances, and resistance 10 against mental damage.

Vile Remnant.name: Vile Remnant
Vile Remnant.gmnote:
When dislodged, mortal fragments like a chewed fingernail, a careless sneeze, or a few strands of hair might fall to the soil and be swiftly forgotten. When a horror like Charg brushes close to reality, the vile remnants cast off from his nightmare form are not so harmless. At other times, the desecrated remains of innocent creatures can be transformed into vile remnants as well. Worshippers of unholy gods and followers of evil philosophies gather these things and covet them as one might the hem of a cloak brushed against an idolized hero, or the visage of a divinity made manifest in a patch of mold on a wall. Vile remnants spread fear and cruelty wherever they're hidden and can corrupt those who discover them. They might be buried in the soil of a farmer's field, dropped into the depths of a village well, or stashed at the bottom of a toy box. Wherever the innocent might stumble across them and become unknowing actors in the decay of morality, the vile remnant works its unholy magic.

A vile remnant appears as a raw, decaying mass of flesh, fur, and gristle—a teratoma consisting of warty skin, sightless eyes, a finger or a toe, tufts of bristly hair, or teeth without mouths or lips to hide them. Each vile remnant's shape is wildly different and uniquely unsettling. A vile remnant automatically imparts to a PC the knowledge of how to use its Hear My Words activation as soon as it's touched, but its other activations must be discovered normally through the use of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} (and as normal, identifying the presence and effect of the curse it carries requires a critical success at such an attempt).

Unlike most cursed items, a character can discard a vile remnant, yet doing so runs a real risk that it might thereafter fall into the wrong hands. In this Adventure Path, any vile remnant the PCs discard anywhere other than the restored reliquary in the Maiserene Church at area A9 is discovered by one of the monsters of Bastardhall, who then Hides the horror somewhere in the region where it was found. Where the horror is hidden is left to you to decide.

As long as a creature carries a vile remnant, its thoughts and dreams are influenced by cruel notions and temptations to commit violent depravities. A creature that's already predisposed toward these acts derives greater pleasure than before for such atrocities but receives no additional penalty or benefit, while a non-sapient creature is driven to become unnaturally violent in its actions (and over the course of weeks, becomes visibly corrupted by patches of strange fur, warty growths, unsightly teeth, or similar teratomas on its body). A sapient creature that isn't predisposed toward acts of depravity (likely including all PCs) takes an item penalty equal to the number of vile remnants they carry to saving throws against all magical effects that attempt to encourage such acts. Saving throws against spells like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qwlh6aDgi86U3Q7H]{Suggestion} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm} cast by creatures who attempt to push a PC into such acts, any affect by such creatures that attempts to control a PC, or certain specific effects mentioned in the text of this adventure would all be affected by this penalty. A creature with the holy trait reduces the overall item penalty imparted by this curse by 1, to a minimum penalty of 0.

A creature that's foolish enough to consume a vile remnant becomes fused to its curse, at which point the vile remnant remains lodged within the creature's body until the curse is removed from the creature with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} spell or similar magic, or upon the creature's death, whichever comes first. At this point, the vile remnant crawls or oozes its way out of the creature's body and flops, once again inanimate, onto the ground, where it waits to be claimed by a new carrier.

As long as you carry a vile remnant somewhere on your person, its curse does have a beneficial side: The power of its influence grants you a +1 item bonus to all saving throws against curses from other sources, as the vile remnant jealously wards against such encroachments on its territory. Unlike the item penalty, carrying multiple vile remnants does not increase this item bonus.

The vile remnant appears to be lifeless.

Activate—Become As One 1 minute (concentrate, manipulate)

Effect By piling eight vile remnants in a heap and then concentrating upon the mound of cursed flesh for a minute, you cause the eight vile remnants to slither together and become a single whispering remnant. Once combined in this manner, the resulting whispering remnant cannot be thereafter split into individual vile remnants.

Activate—Hear My Words 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect The vile remnant casts a DC 23 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IihxWhRfpsBgQ5jS]{Enthrall} spell to your specifications. Creatures that fail or critically fail to resist this spell perceive and remember the vile remnant in your hand as something commonplace to the region, such as a farming tool, book, or fresh-baked pie, for as long as they remain enthralled. If you don't take advantage of this to subtly guide any affected creatures toward undermining their society, the vile remnant can't be activated to Hear My Words again by you for 1 week. Additionally, the next time you sleep, you endure horrific nightmares and must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:23] save upon waking to avoid becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 24 hours (this is a mental effect).

Activate—Hide the Horror 10 minutes (manipulate)

Frequency once per year

Effect You hide the vile remnant somewhere that, in time, it is likely to be found. For the following four weeks, the vile remnant's evil seeps into the surrounding landscape, expanding its influence at a rate of 200 feet per day until it reaches its maximum emanation of 5,600 feet after 28 days. It continues to influence this area for another three weeks before going dormant—it must be recovered and rehidden later once this activation recharges to begin the cycle again. While the remnant's influence is active, any sapient creature that sleeps in the area experiences unsettling dreams of being stalked by monsters they can never quite see or evade. A creature that doesn't worship an unholy deity who experiences these dreams must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:23] save each time they rest to avoid awakening @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}. On a critical failure, the creature awakens stupefied 1 as well; this condition remains until removed or until they are no longer fatigued, whichever comes first. Creatures who worship an unholy deity or follow a despicable philosophy are immune to this effect. Any skill checks made by such creatures when performing rituals performed in the affected area gain a +1 item bonus, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Uqj344bezBq3ESdq]{Nightmare} spells cast by them within the region have their save DCs increased by 1.

Destruction A vile remnant can't be destroyed.

Alisendra's Fan.name: Alisendra's Fan
Alisendra's Fan.gmnote:
Each Arudora memento is unique in appearance, but all seven are approximately the same size. Carried by each of the cursed family members, these mementos have within them the power to unlock entire portions of Bastardhall from the ghostly cursed state the castle traditionally exists in.

Activate—Return Memento 3 (manipulate) You place the memento into the appropriate statue's clutches in the fountain located in area B3 of Bastardhall. The statue briefly animates to claim the memento, which turns to stone and becomes thereafter a permanent part of the statue, effectively destroying the memento while granting a boon to the party that persists for the remainder of this Adventure Path. When this elegant crimson hand fan is Returned, the dungeon (detailed in Chapter 5) is unlocked. The souls trapped in Bastardhall appreciate the end of Alisendra's dominion and now whisper hints of truths in the ears of those who seek knowledge. The DCs for all checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} are reduced by 1 for the rest of the Adventure Path.

Destruction An Arudora memento is destroyed when it's activated with Return Memento, and the boon it grants upon this returning lasts until the very end of the Adventure Path.

A soulheart is a crystallized sphere of red ectoplasm about the size of a human eye. When held by a living creature, a faint red light shimmers within the crystal, pulsating in a synchronized beat with the creature's heartbeat and providing illumination equivalent to that of a candle.

Activate—Restore Life 1 minute (concentrate, manipulate)

Effect By holding a pure soulheart against the remains of a dead creature of 20th level or lower that has been dead for no more than a year and concentrating for one minute, the pure soulheart flashes with red light and is destroyed. The targeted dead creature is restored to life with 1 Hit Point, no spells prepared or spell slots available, no points in any pools or any other daily resources, and is still affected by any long-term debilitations of the old body.

Destruction A pure soulheart is destroyed when it is activated to Restore Life.

The spell then treats the ally as you for the purpose of the spell. Additionally, you're immune to the spell and able to approach the ally with ease.

Moonweave (Greater).description: 你的护甲会以清冷的月光沐浴你的伤口。穿着此护甲时，每当你将要受到法术或魔法效果的治疗，你额外恢复@Damage[5[healing]]生命值。你从月织护甲获得的额外生命值仅在你从某个特定治疗法术或效果中首次恢复生命值时生效，因此一个在持续时间内重复治疗你的法术或效果只会在你首次被治疗时提供一次额外生命值恢复。

Evercursed Crystal.description: Most of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.mRz8Jmk4Q06SsZpC]{Everlight Crystals} that once lit so much of Castle Arudora have been destroyed over the years, but those that remain have illuminated certain locations (particularly the reception halls) for hundreds of years since the curse fell—becoming cursed themselves in the process. As long as an evercursed crystal remains in a lantern, chandelier, sconce, or other mounting found in Bastardhall, it remains harmless and sheds light as an everlight crystal. As soon as a creature removes an evercursed crystal from its mounting, though, the light it exudes forever changes to a dim, unnerving red glow the same strength as a candle. A character takes a –1 item penalty to all saving throws against curse effects while carrying an evercursed crystal, but fortunately these minor cursed items lack the ability to fuse to a character.

Commander's Signet.description:
A commander’s signet is typically a silver ring emblazoned with the coat of arms or heraldry of a wealthy noble family, or the insignia of a mercenary group. A badge of office often worn by soldiers during the Shining Crusade in Ustalav, many commander’s signets bear iconography associated with Aroden, Arazni, or Iomedae, but those found in this adventure bear the heraldry of the Arudora family. The signet grants a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} or to Intimidation checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce}, and can be activated to bolster the morale of a nearby target.

Velicarn's Cursed Coin.description:
This platinum coin was minted in Caliphas in the year 4192, the same year that Velicarn, the eponymous bastard of Bastardhall, was born. While the design of coins has changed in the 500 or so years since this one was minted, anyone who is at least an expert in Society recognizes that this coin's design resembles no known Ustalavic tradition—and in fact, when the coin became cursed on that vile night in 4213, its imagery forever changed. In the present day, one side of the coin depicts a distorted image of the Arudora family crest, while the other depicts a set of monstrous eyes peering through the cracks in a crumbling wall (identifiable as the religious symbol of Charg with a Religion check to [[/act recall-knowledge skill=religion dc=25]]).

The coin feels unusually heavy for being made of platinum, and no merchant will accept it as cash as a result. Most merchants and collectors who are presented with the coin have an instinctual distaste for its strange weight and slightly greasy feel. As soon as someone carries Velicarn's cursed coin for longer than a minute, it automatically becomes invested, fuses with that person, and continues to count against that character's invested items, even without being reinvested each day. As long as the coin is carried, sahkils prefer to target the coin's carrier with their attacks (although they are not forced to do so), often behaving as if they can smell the "stink of the Typhon Wheel" on them. Fortunately for a character cursed by this item, the coin has no further debilitating effects, save for when it is activated.

Activate—Daring or Dread 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You [[/r 1dc#Velicarn's Cursed Coin]]{flip the coin}, with a 50/50 chance of getting heads (the Arudora crest) or tails (the symbol of Charg). If the result is heads, you become immune to fear effects for 1 hour. If the result is tails, you gain a –2 item penalty against fear saves for 24 hours. If it's after dark in Bastardhall when you activate Velicarn's cursed coin, you must twice check to determine if you get heads or tails, and you only get the heads result if both coin flips result in heads; otherwise, the result is tails.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.a2DB0gqfriXhU1PU]{Effect: Velicarn's Cursed Coin}

The fiddle was stolen from the contract devil who created it, and the cunning fiend still wants to reclaim the instrument. Fiendish misfortunes often befall its owners, allowing it to switch hands. The fiddle is a handheld @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.3ld14dsn2RLu9owg]{Musical Instrument (Virtuoso handheld)}.

Grand Gift @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.HZz6x19bNbeCVQsN]{Artistic Perfection} (Performance)

Possum's Play (Greater).description:
Activate F (concentrate)

Trigger You would take damage from an attack or magical effect.

This innocuous little charm looks like nothing so much as a patch of coarse white or dark gray fur, usually made to resemble a lucky rabbit's foot or something else. When you activate the talisman, the triggering attack gains the nonlethal trait, and you fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, feigning death. An illusion surrounds you, causing you to appear dead for up to 1 hour. Any creature that touches the illusion or uses the [[/act seek]] action to examine you can attempt to disbelieve the illusion. The DC to disbelieve the illusion is 24. Any action requiring you to move or make noise immediately ends the illusion.
Possum's Play (Greater).name: Possum's Play (Greater)

Phase Spike.description:
The head of this +1 striking astral spear is partially translucent. Thieves and battlefield spellcasters favor it for its ability to pierce magical barriers and temporarily disable enchanted objects. A creature that has Raised its Shield (or similar ability) takes a –1 circumstance penalty to its AC against attacks from a phase spike.

Activate—Incorporeal Stride 2 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You focus on the head of the spear and channel its properties into your form. You Stride up to your Speed. You can move easily through solid objects and creatures during this movement, but you can't end this movement within a solid object or in a creature's space. You also gain resistance 10 to all damage during this Stride (except force or spirit damage and damage caused by a ghost touch rune); double this resistance against non-magical damage.
Phase Spike.name: Phase Spike

Quotidian Staff (Greater).description:
This humble oak staff is etched with a geometric pattern. Quotidian staves are popular among those with minor magical abilities to handle everyday tasks. While wielding the staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Lore checks about food or drink.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Qw3fnUlaUbnn7ipC]{Prestidigitation}

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.X9dkmh23lFwMjrYd]{Ant Haul}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qJ7GCq9su3DKHFtR]{Fishing Spot}

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dINQzhqGmIsqGMUY]{Mending}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.l194BTf9cAFlSQ96]{Thermal Remedy}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
Quotidian Staff (Greater).name: Quotidian Staff (Greater)

Energy Vulnerability.description: 铭刻了此符文的武器会呈现出与创造符文时所选能量类型相对应颜色的光泽：绿色（酸蚀）、蓝色（寒冷）、白色（电击）、橙色（火焰）或黄色（音波）。当你用带有此符文的武器重击一个目标时，目标获得对所选能量类型的弱点5，持续至你的下一回合结束。该弱点不与目标已拥有的任何该能量类型的弱点叠加，且不影响对该能量类型具有免疫或抗力的生物。
Energy Vulnerability.name: 能量弱点 Energy Vulnerability

Discordant Strings.description:
Activate Cast a Spell

Strings used during a mediocre performance are bound together with silver thread and kept in a sealed container. When used as a catalyst to cast a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TSyFZNAbqfkRrcq0]{Concordant Choir} spell, a creature that fails its saving throw is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.
Discordant Strings.name: Discordant Strings

Staff of the Mage's Friend (Greater).description:
When this staff is prepared, the carved wooden animal figurine atop it shifts to resemble the owner's familiar. While wielding this staff, you can communicate telepathically with your familiar, even if it doesn't normally understand or speak a language, with a range of 30 feet.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.AfOpnnwdZwHi2Tnc]{Protect Companion}

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.F1nlmqOIucch3Cmt]{Pet Cache}

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aZHjRVBDV9dyo1ro]{Floating Harness}

  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.JFGOsnTeYOhaOa8f]{Familiar's Call}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.T8Ymeig4Fv2HrzjF]{Tiny Wings}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
Staff of the Mage's Friend (Greater).name: Staff of the Mage's Friend (Greater)

Void Sickle.description:
This +1 striking ghost touch sickle is made of an impossibly dark steel that absorbs all surrounding light, causing shadows to cling to its blade and those around it to feel an unnatural chill.

Activate—Light Harvest 1 (darkness, manipulate, void)

Frequency once per day

Effect You swing the void sickle in a wide arc, drawing light into the blade. All non-magical light sources within 30 feet are immediately extinguished, and the next melee Strike you make with the void sickle before the end of your turn deals an additional @Damage[1d6[void]] damage.
Void Sickle.name: Void Sickle

Mistwalker's Instinct.description:
Activate Cast a Spell

Wisps of fog and mist waft from this smooth, polished amulet in the shape of a raindrop. When used as a catalyst to cast a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist} spell, you can sense the direction of each creature from you within the mist, though you can't instinctively discern allies from enemies based on direction alone. The DC of flat checks you attempt to target a creature within the mist is reduced from 5 to 3.
Mistwalker's Instinct.name: Mistwalker's Instinct

All-Seeing Eye (Greater).description:
This glass eyeball is slightly uncanny due to the two brightly colored crystal irises it sports on opposing sides. It helps combatants see their foes even in the darkest of situations. The spell DC of any spell cast by Activating this item is 20.

  • Armor You gain resistance 4 to damage from illusion effects.

  • Weapon (fortune) After you cast a light spell by Activating the eye, your own eyesight sharpens until the end of your next turn. If you fail the flat check to target a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or hidden opponent with a Strike with the weapon, you can reroll it and take the new result.

@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic|name:All-Seeing Eye Spell|traits:spell|showDC:all]

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light}.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}.
All-Seeing Eye (Greater).name: All-Seeing Eye (Greater)

Wanderer’s Staff (Greater).description:
The outlines of topographical maps are burned into this wooden staff's surface, though they constantly change to reflect the surrounding terrain. While wielding this staff, you get a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to Sense Direction or Subsist in the wild.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.tXa5vOu5giBNCjdR]{Know the Way}

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4WAib3GichxLjp5p]{Alarm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.PGVhjDbzC4lf6aXF]{Breadcrumbs}

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Mt6ZzkVX8Q4xigFq]{Create Food}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5esP2GVzvxWsMgaX]{Environmental Endurance}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPKJOhEihhcIm2uQ]{Marvelous Mount}

  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qXTB7Ec9yYh5JPPV]{Cleanse Cuisine}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.UMngJlyjDWdFyKCi]{Spontaneous Cartography}

  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Mt6ZzkVX8Q4xigFq]{Create Food}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{Unfettered Movement}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
Wanderer’s Staff (Greater).name: Wanderer’s Staff (Greater)

Fanged Staff.description:
Carved of the finest bloodwood, this staff is an elegant walking stick with a sharp metal point at its base. Fanged staves are popular among favored mortal retainers of vampires. While wielding a fanged staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against void effects.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4gBIw4IDrSfFHik4]{Daze}

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{Command}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.k34hDOfIIMAxNL4a]{Grim Tendrils}

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.TaaMEYdZXQXF0Sks]{Blood Vendetta}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NVeN6RrFu12HnTne]{Draw Blood}

  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IihxWhRfpsBgQ5jS]{Enthrall}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.N1Z1oLPdBxaSgrEE]{Vampiric Feast}

  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5zeSxzDxMSr0wgSF]{Sanguine Mist}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.07xYlmGX32XtHGEt]{Vampiric Maiden}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
Fanged Staff.name: Fanged Staff

Energy Shield Tunic (Greater).description:
这件光滑、可变色的束腰外衣拥有比大多数衣物更高的纱线密度。它是一件+2高等韧性探险者服装，能帮助穿戴者抵御强大的能量魔法。在你进行每日准备时，从下列能量类型中选择一种：酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰或音波。你对所选能量类型获得15点抗力，持续至你的下一次每日准备。束腰外衣会根据所选能量类型改变颜色并添加主题刺绣。

  • 酸蚀 束腰外衣变为棕色，并用亮绿色丝线绣出飞溅的酸液图案。

  • 寒冷 束腰外衣变为天蓝色，并用银色丝线绣出雪花图案。

  • 电击 束腰外衣变为深灰色，并用浅蓝色丝线绣出闪电图案。

  • 火焰 束腰外衣变为橙色，并用红色和黄色丝线绣出火球图案。

  • 音波 束腰外衣变为白色，并用金色丝线绣出音符图案。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.7NImqTYZ5Yg9gkM3]

启动—防护指令（Shielding Command） r （幸运，操作）

频率 每日一次

触发 你即将对一个会造成酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰或音波伤害的法术进行豁免检定，但尚未掷骰

效果 将触发的豁免检定掷两次，取较好的结果。
Energy Shield Tunic (Greater).name: 高等能量防护服 Energy Shield Tunic (Greater)

Moonweave.description: 你的护甲会以清冷的月光沐浴你的伤口。穿着此护甲时，每当你将要受到法术或魔法效果的治疗，你额外恢复@Damage[2[healing]]生命值。你从月织护甲获得的额外生命值仅在你从某个特定治疗法术或效果中首次恢复生命值时生效，因此一个在持续时间内重复治疗你的法术或效果只会在你首次被治疗时提供一次额外生命值恢复。
Moonweave.name: 月织 Moonweave

Chiromantic Lines.description:
These tattoos boast minute, intricate inscriptions, inked with dust ground from the eyelashes of omen dragons. The process is incredibly painful, involving tattooing one's pupils as well as one's palm lines with an almost invisible series of tracings.

Activate—Cunning Consultation 1 (concentrate, prediction)

Frequency once per day

Effect This tattoo becomes temporarily visible, allowing you to briefly grasp the very near future just enough to predict the subtle movements of those around you. Until the end of the turn, all creatures you can see that are not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or hidden are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to you.
Chiromantic Lines.name: Chiromantic Lines

Book of Endless Walls.description:
A circular labyrinth is etched onto this tome's cover, its lines shimmering silver. Touching the book causes a sense of faint discombobulation.

Activate—Bewildering Walls f (concentrate, mental, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your next action is to Cast a prepared wall spell, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IarZrgCeaiUqOuRu]{Wall of Fire} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KsWhliKfUs3IpW3c]{Wall of Thorns}, you imbue the wall with an uncanny sense of disorientation, causing creatures to perceive it as an endless labyrinth. Any creature that begins its turn within the wall's spaces or passes through the wall's spaces must attempt a Will save against your spell DC, in addition to the wall's normal effect. Regardless of the results, the target then becomes immune to Bewildering Walls for 24 hours.

Critical Success The wall has no additional effect for that creature.

Success The creature is bewildered by its perceptions of labyrinthine walls and treats all other creatures as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} for 1 round.

Failure The creature treats all other creatures as hidden for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature treats all other creatures as hidden for 1 round and concealed for 1 minute.
Book of Endless Walls.name: Book of Endless Walls

Healer's Gel.description:
Activate Cast a Spell

An astringent aroma from rare succulent plants wafts off these soothing cloth patches. Adding this material component to a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} spell bestows an additional 5 temporary Hit Points to one target healed by the spell. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.sOwAqyQ6MaoSqaY1]{Effect: Healer's Gel}
Healer's Gel.name: Healer's Gel

Bottled Melody.description:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

This potion is a melody in clear liquid form, with little musical notations swimming and darting through it like fish. You gain the Songburst action for 1 hour after you imbibe this concoction.

Songburst 1 (auditory, sonic) You vocalize a high-pitched melody that deals @Damage[4d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] (@Check[fortitude|dc:23|basic] save). A creature that fails the saving throw is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure). After you use Songburst, you can't do so again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge do so]]{1d4 rounds}.
Bottled Melody.name: Bottled Melody

Corrosive Staff (Greater).description:
A sickly green liquid sloshes inside this hollow glass staff, carrying an acrid scent. While wielding the staff, you gain resistance 6 to acid damage.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.thAHF1zxNplLCJPO]{Caustic Blast}

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rnNGALRtsjspFTws]{Acidic Burst}

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9h9YCncqah6VNsKf]{Acid Grip}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NWIDE4XKtL3Nb4pO]{Disintegrating Puddle}

  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rnNGALRtsjspFTws]{Acidic Burst}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3A3ueS9Q0s3U8KXE]{Noxious Metals}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
Corrosive Staff (Greater).name: Corrosive Staff (Greater)

Shatterpoint Ammunition.description:
Ammunition any

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Crafted out of spite to counter a caster's animated objects, shatterpoint ammunition hums quiet songs of destruction. When activated shatterpoint ammunition hits a target, the damage the ammunition deals ignores the target's Hardness if it's 4 or lower. In addition, the target takes @Damage[1d8[persistent,sonic]] damage from the vibrations.
Shatterpoint Ammunition.name: Shatterpoint Ammunition

Ghostly Legerdemain.description:
Activate Cast a Spell

Patterns shift subtly on the surface of this torn fingerless leather glove. When used as a catalyst to cast a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qTr2oCgIXl703Whb]{Thoughtful Gift} spell, you can choose to place the object in the target's backpack or other container in their possession if they don't have a free hand. The spell fails if the object can't fit in the container or if you choose an extradimensional container.
Ghostly Legerdemain.name: Ghostly Legerdemain

Poet's Fritter (Lesser).name: Poet's Fritter (Lesser)
Poet's Fritter (Lesser).description:
The flavor of the cinnamon apple pastry called a poet's fritter is more than delicious—it inspires the tongue to great acts of spoken eloquence. When eaten, a poet's fritter not only bolsters your knack at telling stories and entertaining with your voice, it also fills your thoughts with the ability to swiftly and adroitly defend your mind from unpleasant mental agonies. For 1 hour, you gain a +1 item bonus to Deception checks to Lie and to Performance checks made for vocal-based performances, and resistance 5 against mental damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.gpsTtIhD8wk2MwbW]{Effect: Poet's Fritter}

Convincing (Greater).description: 服众符文会融入你护甲的装饰元素中，例如浮雕图案和彩色饰物。穿戴此护甲时，你在[[/act make-an-impression]]和请求的交涉检定中获得+2物品加值。
Convincing (Greater).name: 高等服众 Convincing (Greater)

Memento Mori Staff.description:
A carved nosoi figurine sits atop this white ash staff, which carries the faint scent of funereal herbs. These staves are often used by Pharasmins to communicate with the unquiet dead and lay them to rest. A memento mori staff is a +2 striking astral staff.

Activate—Pierce the Veil 1 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per hour

Effect The staff searches for undead, warming to your touch if there are any undead within 60 feet. It cannot identify the precise location of the undead, nor their exact numbers. You can Sustain this effect for a maximum of 1 minute.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kcelf6IHl3L9VXXg]{Vitality Lash}

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2iQKhCQBijhj5Rf3]{Infuse Vitality}

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D7yI9WPr9ahkaXNf]{Palm-Held Sun}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3ehSrqTAm7IPqbIZ]{Spirit Sense}

  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.y3jlOfgsQH1JjkJE]{Anointed Ground}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Stjb9wvLn146TfW6]{Reblooded}

  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WVc30DGbM7TRLLul]{Ghostly Tragedy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FM3SmEW8N1FCRjqt]{Talking Corpse}

  • 5th@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2iQKhCQBijhj5Rf3]{ Infuse Vitality}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.QW2gYIKce3W31xXf]{Peaceful Rest}

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
Memento Mori Staff.name: Memento Mori Staff

Undertaker's Spade.description:
Activate Cast a Spell

Rites of rest are etched deep into the broken-off blade of a deceased gravekeeper's shovel. When used as a catalyst to cast an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.oXeEbcUdgJGWHGEJ]{Impaling Spike} spell, the blade disintegrates into dust, mixing with the earth and allowing the spell to damage incorporeal creatures as if it were a weapon imbued with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch} property rune. An incorporeal creature can be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} by a spike if it's adjacent to a solid surface when struck; it can attempt to Escape as normal but can't phase through the spike or escape to the Ethereal Plane.
Undertaker's Spade.name: Undertaker's Spade

Shield of Mental Fortitude.description:
这面小型钢制小圆盾（硬度6，HP24，BT12）上雕刻着一个完整的金色圆圈。当你举起此盾时，你获得心灵伤害抗力5。

启动—心灵反冲（Mind Backlash） r （操作）

频率 每日一次

触发 你在举起固神盾时，对一项心灵效果的意志豁免成功

效果 你向该生物回敬一波灵能波动。造成触发心灵效果的生物必须通过@Check[will|dc:27]豁免，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 1}（大失败则@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{呆滞 Stupefied 2}）。
Shield of Mental Fortitude.name: 固神盾 Shield of Mental Fortitude

Fan of the Four Winds.description:
The fan of the four winds once belonged to a sage of Gozreh and was passed down as a sacred relic for generations to those found worthy. Since that time, no one has unlocked the fan's full powers, though many devout priests have used it to aid them in their travels. A worthy member of this order might receive the fan as a reward, as could a suitable helper of the clergy. The fan might also have been lost, allowing for a new wielder to find it. The fan of the four winds has the following activation.

Activate 2 concentrate, manipulate

Frequency once per day

Effect You fan in a direction, and the fan casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.g8QqHpv2CWDwmIm1]{Gust of Wind}. If this casting is directed toward the sail of a vessel, it instead fills it with swirling air. The vessel gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed for 8 hours.
Fan of the Four Winds.name: Fan of the Four Winds
Fan of the Four Winds.gmnote:
Aspects air

Minor Gifts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.zQnx7VDfZQfeR1PR]{Feather Steps}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.UEBVXi4VSQf70ggQ]{Wind Barrier}

Major Gifts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.GPKJlAiRXfBThxDr]{Lightning Storm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.qL44lR8sZMWgY1r7]{Propelling Winds}

Grand Gift @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.zGPkm78SqX1xgnzQ]{Living Storm}

Kindler Cameo.description:
This small gold cameo in the shape of an oval hangs on a delicate silver chain. When opened, the cameo reveals tiny paintings of a man and a woman—Florin Kindler's parents. When the Kindler cameo is invested, the images within shift in appearance to portray the two most important people in the wearer's life.

Activate—Recall Better Times2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You open the cameo and regard the images within of the two most important people in your life, bolstering yourself with fond memories. You regain @Damage[(3d10+12)[healing]|traits:concentrate,manipulate] Hit Points, and you gain a +2 status bonus to Will saves for 1 minute. You also immediately recover from any persistent damage you're currently taking.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.WBA8VOIbJJv93EB7]{Effect: Kindler Cameo}

Activate—Sense Soulheart 1 minute (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Requirements You are in Bastardhall while the castle is cursed

Effect By clutching the closed cameo in a fist, shutting your eyes, and concentrating, the cameo's magic reaches out through Bastardhall toward the closest soulheart. At the end of a minute of concentration, you know the direction and approximate distance to a nearby soulheart (this is typically, but not always, the closest soulheart). This activation doesn't discern between soulhearts whose locations you already know about or not, and as such, Activating this power while you or a nearby ally carry a soulheart isn't particularly helpful. The cameo can't detect a soulheart that's still within a section of Bastardhall that hasn't yet been unlocked. If no soulhearts can be detected, you know this, but the activation's daily use is still consumed.

Dreamer's Butterfly.description:
These twin tattoos, each depicting the ornate wing of a butterfly or moth, are usually placed upon your palms or wrists. While sleeping, this tattoo crafts lucid dreams that don't disturb your rest; However, when danger arises, these dreams shift to alert you to trouble and shroud you in camouflaging dream-stuff. As a result, you do not take any penalty to Perception checks when asleep. When asleep, you also gain a +2 circumstance to your Will saves against effects with the dream or sleep traits.

Activate—Wake the Dream 1 (illusion, manipulate, mental)

Effect By touching the two halves of the tattoo together, the wings expand to show a small illusory rendition of any effects with the dream or sleep traits you are currently subject to. Onlookers (including yourself) gain a +1 status bonus to checks to Identify Magic of any spells or magical effects with the dream or sleep traits for 1 round.

Special An adjacent ally can also Activate this effect by touching the two halves of your tattoo together if you are willing or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.
Dreamer's Butterfly.name: Dreamer's Butterfly

这件+1探索者服装是一套简单、实用且低调的两件式装束。舒适的布料附有幻术魔法，使其看起来像是穿着重甲（如同幻术伪装）。穿着此套装时，你在乔装成通常穿重甲的人物的欺骗检定中获得+3物品加值。

Fortune's Favor.description: Blessed by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.Mv6uTJLh3VGEoGLH]{Nivi Rhombodazzle}, this striking silver necklace is adorned with sparkling sapphires that draw the eye of any who see it. Over the years, this necklace has appeared in many paintings and illustrations, usually around the neck of a carefree and daring adventurer or a stylish rake gambling vast sums of coin. Finding this relic is always seen as a sign of great fortune to come, but when that luck runs out, the necklace is lost just as quickly. Wearing the relic, you quickly realize how distracting it can be, granting you a +1 item bonus on Deception checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} and on Games Lore checks made to gamble or determine the outcome of a game of chance.
Fortune's Favor.name: Fortune's Favor

这把+1手弩附有增强精准的魔力，能更容易命中具有一定防护的目标。

启动—弧线箭矢（Curve Bolt） 2

频率 每日一次

General's Signet.description:
A general’s signet is typically a silver ring emblazoned with the coat of arms or heraldry of a wealthy noble family, or the insignia of a mercenary group. A badge of office often worn by soldiers during the Shining Crusade in Ustalav, many general’s signets bear iconography associated with Aroden, Arazni, or Iomedae, but those found in this adventure bear the heraldry of the Arudora family. The signet grants a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} or to Intimidation checks made to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tHCqgwjtQtzNqVvd]{Coerce}, and can be activated to bolster the morale of a nearby target.

Activate—Bolster Bravery 2 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You fill a creature you touch with bravery and heroic conviction, granting it a +2 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks for 1 minute. The status bonus is doubled for saving throws made against fear effects.

General's Signet.name: General's Signet

Fearcutter.description:
In his days as an adventurer, Eragayl Arudora made a name for himself as a champion of Shelyn. Devoted to the cause of grandeur, Eragayl eschewed the typical glaive of her champions and instead focused his skills on the longsword and shield. It was his shield that gained Shelyn's blessings, but by the time he retired and began building Castle Arudora, Eragayl's sword, Fearcutter, was arguably his most legendary belonging. With this blade, he slew countless undead and fiends, including the monstrous sahkil Vormingundur, who for many years tormented a dozen small settlements along the southwest border of Varno before meeting his end on this blade's edge.

Fearcutter is a +2 striking astral vitalizing longsword that grants a +2 item bonus to saving throws against fear effects while you carry it unsheathed. When you critically hit a creature with the unholy trait with Fearcutter, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.0hTMq4EhJF7raRJN]{Effect: Helping Hand - Weapon}

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]{Telekinetic Hand}.

Soulheart (Angelic).description:
A soulheart is a crystallized sphere of red ectoplasm about the size of a human eye. When held by a living creature, a faint red light shimmers within the crystal, pulsating in a synchronized beat with the creature's heartbeat and providing illumination equivalent to that of a candle.

Activate—Defy Charg 1 (concentrate, manipulate)

Requirements Pharasma's favor (earned by restoring the temple clock tower in Bastardhall), Shelyn's favor (earned by restoring the gallery in Bastardhall's reception halls), and Caydserris Arudora is defeated

Effect By presenting the angelic soulheart to Charg at the climax of this Adventure Path, you can fully remove the Bastardhall Curse and free all of the souls trapped within!

Destruction An angelic soulheart is destroyed when it is activated to Defy Charg.
Soulheart (Angelic).name: Soulheart (Angelic)

Chapbook of Terrors (Major).description:
This lurid pamphlet contains spooky tales about ghosts, monsters, and murderers, all illustrated in gruesome detail. The stories, fortunately, are only fictions… or are they?

Activate—Horrify 1 (concentrate, mental, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your next action is to Cast a prepared Spell with the fear trait, creatures frightened by the spell also take @Damage[4d6[persistent,mental]] damage as they dwell on your terrifying tale.
Chapbook of Terrors (Major).name: Chapbook of Terrors (Major)

Radiant Tome.description:
A flawless diamond embedded into the cover of this tome gleams with an inner light, refracting multicolored rays to the eyes of viewers.

Activate—Flare 1 (concentrate, light, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your next action is to Cast a prepared Spell with the light trait, the luminescence of the book grows even more intense, emitting bright light in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] for 1 minute. Enemies that start their turn in this bright light must attempt a Fortitude save against your spell DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to this bright light for 1 minute.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded until the start of your next turn and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 minute.
Radiant Tome.name: Radiant Tome

Resolute Shield.description:
这面大型塔盾（硬度12，HP96，BT48）的边缘布满凹痕与磨损，承载着数十年战斗留下的擦伤与印记。

启动—坚定屹立（Stand Firm） r （专注）

频率 每小时一次

触发 你举着坚定之盾，且将因一次重击命中而受到物理伤害

效果 坚定之盾阻止你承受最多两倍该盾硬度的伤害。你和盾牌各自承受剩余的伤害。
Resolute Shield.name: 坚定之盾 Resolute Shield

Salve of Mental Pattern.description:
启动 1 （操作）

这个小瓶中盛有一种暗沉的银灰色软膏。将其涂在自愿生物身上时，它会凝结出一层精妙的花边状分形网纹，覆盖目标的身体周围，赋予其心灵伤害抗力10，持续10分钟；此后网纹剥落，化为粉末碎屑。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.53nZ2aLLzny1p1j7]
Salve of Mental Pattern.name: 心纹软膏 Salve of Mental Pattern

Arclord's Codex.description:
The techniques bound in the spellbooks of the Arclords of Nex are jealously guarded secrets, and an Arclord gives up their grimoire only under the direst of circumstances. These grimoires vary in appearance based on their owner's taste, but all display the Arclords' symbol of an eye within a triangle on the cover. Possession of an Arclord's codex signifies mastery of powerful magic, and anyone who steals such a tome is sure to find themself hunted across the world—or the multiverse, if necessary—by its owner.

Activate—Third Eye Rejuvenation f (concentrate, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

Effect If your next action is to Cast a prepared 10th-rank arcane spell, the magical energies reinvigorate your spellcasting. You regain access to two spells of 4th rank or lower or one spell of 5th rank or higher that you've prepared and already cast today.
Arclord's Codex.name: Arclord's Codex

Shatterpoint Ammunition (Major).description:
Ammunition any

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Crafted out of spite to counter a caster's animated objects, shatterpoint ammunition hums quiet songs of destruction. When activated shatterpoint ammunition hits a target, the damage the ammunition deals ignores the target's Hardness if it's 12 or lower. In addition, the target takes @Damage[3d8[persistent,sonic]] damage from the vibrations.
Shatterpoint Ammunition (Major).name: Shatterpoint Ammunition (Major)

Nine Void Sleeves.description:
The ink on these tattoos, made from the crushed crystalline fangs and wingbones of sceaduinars, lends a dull purple-black hue to your arms and hands. During combat, the ink moves of its own accord, coalescing into nine smoky crystal spurs of darkness; these eerie finger-like protrusions move with an unearthly grace on your command, supplying the requisite magical gestures for your spells.

Activate—Shadow Fingers 1 (concentrate, shadow, spellshape)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect If your next action is to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.aBQ8ajvEBByv45yz]{Cast a Spell} with the void trait, your spell loses the manipulate trait and gains the shadow trait, as the tattoo's shadowy spurs perform the gestures in your stead.
Nine Void Sleeves.name: Nine Void Sleeves

Sunweave (Major).description:
你的护甲柔和地发光，赋予你在察觉检定上的+3物品加值。

启动—野心微光（Glint of Ambition） f （专注，幸运）

频率 每日一次

触发 你即将进行一次用于先攻的察觉检定

效果 你为该检定掷骰两次，并取较好的结果。
Sunweave (Major).name: 上等日织 Sunweave (Major)

Augsten's Cudgel.name: Augsten's Cudgel
Augsten's Cudgel.gmnote:
Each Arudora memento is unique in appearance, but all seven are approximately the same size. Carried by each of the cursed family members, these mementos have within them the power to unlock entire portions of Bastardhall from the ghostly cursed state the castle traditionally exists in.

Activate—Return Memento 3 (manipulate) You place the memento into the appropriate statue's clutches in the fountain located in area B3 of Bastardhall. The statue briefly animates to claim the memento, which turns to stone and becomes thereafter a permanent part of the statue, effectively destroying the memento while granting a boon to the party that persists for the remainder of this Adventure Path. When this bloodstained wooden cudgel is Returned, the reception halls (detailed in Chapter 4) are unlocked. Sometimes, violence is the only answer, and swift action to combat is rewarded. For the rest of the Adventure Path, all PCs gain a +1 bonus to any initiative rolls; this special bonus combines with all other bonuses.

Destruction An Arudora memento is destroyed when it's activated with Return Memento, and the boon it grants upon this returning lasts until the very end of the Adventure Path.

Grudge Journal.description:
The margins of this clothbound journal's pages are filled with complaints on all manner of topics, shifting to match whatever angers the bearer most.

Activate—Air Grievance 1 (concentrate, curse, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

Effect You inscribe the name or description of a creature you can see that has wronged you in some way. If your next action is to target that creature with a prepared spell with the curse trait that requires a saving throw, the creature also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} unless it critically succeeds its saving throw.
Grudge Journal.name: Grudge Journal

Preserved Alecost.description:
Activate Cast a Spell

A faint scent of sweetness and bitterness wafts from this dried, preserved herb. When used as a catalyst to cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Mt6ZzkVX8Q4xigFq]{Create Food} spell, the created food becomes flavorful and pleasing. Anyone who eats this food gains 1 temporary Hit Point per rank of the spell that lasts for 1 hour.
Preserved Alecost.name: Preserved Alecost

Energizing Vial (Major).description:
This sealed glass vial has no stopper and is filled with pure white light. The spell attack modifier of any spell cast by Activating this item is [[/r 1d20+28 #spell attack roll]]{+28} and spell DC is 38.

  • Armor After you cast an electricity spell by Activating the energizing vial, you can Step as a free action once per round until the end of your next turn.

  • Weapon After you cast an electricity spell by Activating the energizing vial, your Strikes with the weapon deal @Damage[1d8[persistent,electricity]] damage until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-effects.Item.UPeHUz2pBR3cd980]{Effect: Energizing Vial - Weapon}

@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic|name:Energizing Vial Spell|traits:spell|showDC:all]

Activate Cast a Spell

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

Effect You cast 8th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MUJe5G1zdR20Iq4y]{Lightning Lasso}

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

Effect You cast 8th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.n7OgbKme4hNwxVwQ]{Draw the Lightning}
Energizing Vial (Major).name: Energizing Vial (Major)

Lockpicker's Oil (Major).description:
启动 1 （操作）

将这种澄澈的黄色油液涂在锁上可以让撬锁事半功倍。在接下来的1分钟内，任何尝试开锁的人在贼活检定上都会获得+3状态加值。此外，在此期间，若任何人的贼活检定首次掷出大失败，将其改为失败。这小瓶的量仅够用于一把锁。
Lockpicker's Oil (Major).name: 上等撬锁油 Lockpicker's Oil (Major)

Look-Me-Not.description:
Activate 1 (concentrate)

This talisman takes the form of a flower from the sweetbriar rose, also called the eglantine rose, tied to the weapon with a bit of string. The talisman's enchantment is such that the flower never wilts. When you activate it, your weapon becomes difficult to look at for 1 minute, as through a shimmer of heat or something seen out of the corner of your eye.

While this effect is active, you gain a +2 status bonus to Deception checks to [[/act feint]]. If you're untrained in Deception, you can use the Feint action anyway and add your level as your proficiency bonus despite being untrained. Additionally, your Strikes and damage from the affixed weapon can't trigger reactions (such as the Shield Block reaction).
Look-Me-Not.name: Look-Me-Not

Robe of Beneficence.description:
这件柔软如脂、顺滑如丝的袍子是一件+2高等韧性探索者服装，由丝绸和独角兽毛制成。后背与肩部缀有成簇的天使羽毛，拼成一对展开翅膀的图案。袍身上饰有细微的阿拉伯式花纹、环纹与旋涡纹，令人心生宁静。穿戴此袍时，你获得一道不可见的纯净与仁慈光环，@Template[type:emanation|distance:30]范围，使你对此光环内的生物进行[[/act make-an-impression]]和请求的交涉检定时，获得+3物品加值。

启动—强制和平（Compelled Nonviolence） 2 （专注，失能，操作）

频率 每日一次

效果 此袍的双翼展开，你的光环闪烁金光，短暂变为可见。光环内对你持敌对、漠然或不友善态度的生物必须尝试一次@Check[will|dc:36]豁免，效果如下。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1}。

失败 该生物陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 2}。

大失败 同失败，且该生物在1轮内无法对你采取任何敌对动作。
Robe of Beneficence.name: 慈善礼袍 Robe of Beneficence
